Benefit Gaji Insentif & reward target BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan Training produk & sales

jobs.title: Host Live Streaming / Live Commerce
jobs.description: Melakukan live streaming untuk mempromosikan dan menjual produk beauty seperti Press On Nails, Eyelash Cluster, beauty accessories, dan produk Nau Nau Beauty lainnya. Menjelaskan detail produk, harga, promo, cara penggunaan, serta keunggulan produk dengan jelas dan menarik. Aktif berinteraksi dengan viewers, menjawab pertanyaan, dan membangun suasana live yang seru. Melakukan demo produk saat live jika diperlukan. Mendorong penjualan dan membantu mencapai target selama live streaming. Mempelajari product knowledge serta promo yang sedang berjalan sebelum live. Menjaga penampilan, attitude, dan komunikasi selama live. Bekerja sama dengan tim untuk evaluasi dan meningkatkan performa live. Kualifikasi: Perempuan usia 18–28 tahun. Percaya diri berbicara di depan kamera. Komunikatif, ceria, ekspresif, dan tidak kaku saat live. Tidak malu melakukan demo produk. Cepat belajar dan mampu menghafal informasi produk. Mampu membangun interaksi dengan penonton. Memiliki kemampuan selling dan berorientasi pada target penjualan. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift. Aktif menggunakan TikTok dan familiar dengan TikTok Shop. Pengalaman sebagai Host Live menjadi nilai tambah, namun fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar. Memiliki ketertarikan pada dunia beauty menjadi nilai tambah. Berdomisili di Makassar/Gowa lebih diutamakan

jobs.title: Business Development  Meta Ads
jobs.description: Job Description / Tanggung Jawab: Mengembangkan strategi pemasaran dan akuisisi customer melalui Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) . Melakukan setup, monitoring, dan optimasi campaign Meta Ads. Memahami dan memiliki pengalaman dalam TikTok Ads/Booster, termasuk setup campaign, targeting audience, optimasi budget, dan monitoring performa iklan. Menentukan target audience berdasarkan karakteristik dan kebutuhan customer. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Sales, Marketing, Content, dan Design untuk meningkatkan hasil campaign. Mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis baru melalui data dan performa campaign. Membuat laporan performa iklan secara berkala serta memberikan rekomendasi improvement. Mengontrol budget advertising agar efektif dan sesuai dengan target perusahaan. Mengikuti perkembangan algoritma, fitur, dan tren terbaru Meta Ads. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 , terbuka untuk semua jurusan. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 - 4 tahun di Meta Ads/Digital Marketing/Business Development . Memahami Facebook Ads & Instagram Ads dari setup hingga optimasi campaign. Memahami Audience Targeting, Retargeting, Lookalike Audience, Custom Audience dan Conversion Campaign. Mampu membaca dan menganalisis data campaign. Memahami dasar Google Analytics, Pixel/Meta Pixel, dan Conversion Tracking menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik dan data-driven mindset . Mampu melakukan testing dan optimasi berdasarkan hasil campaign. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik. Target-oriented, proaktif, dan mampu bekerja dengan deadline. Mampu menggunakan Excel/Google Sheets untuk pengolahan dan analisis data.

jobs.title: field service engineer khusus service laser cutting mesin dan bending mesin
jobs.company: PT SLT LASER BENDING MACHINE INDONESIA
jobs.description: FIELD SERVICE ENGINEER PT. SLT Laser Bending Machine Indonesia Deskripsi Pekerjaan Field Service Engineer bertanggung jawab melakukan instalasi, commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance, perbaikan, dan pelayanan teknis terhadap mesin-mesin industri yang dipasarkan oleh PT. SLT Laser Bending Machine Indonesia, khususnya mesin Laser Cutting, CNC Press Brake/Bending, Laser Welding, Laser Tube Cutting, Laser Marking , dan mesin fabrikasi lainnya. Tugas & Tanggung Jawab Melakukan instalasi dan commissioning mesin di lokasi customer. Melakukan pengecekan kondisi mesin sebelum dan setelah instalasi. Melakukan setting, adjustment, dan calibration mesin agar dapat beroperasi sesuai spesifikasi. Melakukan troubleshooting terhadap masalah mekanik, elektrik, pneumatic, hydraulic, control system, dan software mesin. Melakukan preventive maintenance dan corrective maintenance. Melakukan pemeriksaan dan penggantian spare part apabila diperlukan. Memberikan training kepada operator/customer mengenai pengoperasian dan perawatan mesin. Memberikan support teknis kepada customer melalui onsite maupun remote support . Melakukan analisa kerusakan dan membuat laporan hasil service. Melakukan follow-up terhadap masalah customer sampai mesin kembali beroperasi dengan normal. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Sales, Engineering, Spare Part, dan Management dalam menangani kebutuhan customer. Membantu melakukan testing mesin sebelum pengiriman maupun setelah mesin tiba di lokasi customer. Membaca dan memahami electrical drawing, mechanical drawing, pneumatic/hydraulic diagram , serta manual mesin. Melakukan komunikasi teknis dengan supplier/principal apabila terdapat masalah yang membutuhkan support lebih lanjut. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas ke berbagai wilayah Indonesia sesuai kebutuhan customer. Menjaga hubungan profesional dengan customer serta memberikan pelayanan after-sales service yang baik. Menjaga peralatan kerja, tools, spare part, dan aset perusahaan yang digunakan selama pekerjaan. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal SMK/D3/S1 Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, Mekatronika, atau bidang terkait . Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Field Service Engineer, Service Engineer, Maintenance Engineer, Technician, atau posisi sejenis lebih diutamakan. Memiliki pengalaman menangani mesin industri/fabrikasi menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami dasar mekanik dan elektrik . Memahami PLC, inverter/servo, sensor, motor, pneumatic, hydraulic, dan sistem kontrol menjadi nilai tambah. Mampu membaca electrical diagram dan mechanical drawing. Mampu menggunakan alat ukur dan tools teknis. Mampu melakukan troubleshooting secara sistematis. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dengan customer. Bersedia bekerja mobile dan melakukan perjalanan dinas ke luar kota. Memiliki SIM A/C menjadi nilai tambah. Disiplin, bertanggung jawab, cepat belajar, memiliki inisiatif, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. Pengalaman menangani Laser Cutting Machine, CNC Press Brake, Laser Welding, atau mesin fabrikasi logam sangat diutamakan. Target / KPI Kecepatan dan ketepatan penyelesaian masalah customer. Keberhasilan instalasi dan commissioning mesin. Tingkat kepuasan customer. Kecepatan response terhadap keluhan customer. Ketepatan laporan service. Minimnya repeat problem akibat kesalahan troubleshooting. Kedisiplinan dalam menjalankan preventive maintenance dan service schedule. Benefit Gaji kompetitif sesuai pengalaman dan kemampuan. Uang makan dan transportasi sesuai kebijakan perusahaan. Uang perjalanan dinas. Insentif/bonus berdasarkan kinerja. Training teknis mengenai mesin dan teknologi terbaru. Kesempatan berkembang menjadi Senior Service Engineer / Technical Supervisor . Lingkungan kerja profesional di bidang mesin industri dan fabrikasi. Penempatan Cikarang Pusat, Jawa Barat Catatan: Kandidat yang memiliki pengalaman menangani mesin laser cutting, CNC bending/press brake, laser welding, atau mesin industri fabrikasi akan menjadi prioritas. FIELD SERVICE ENGINEER

PT. SLT Laser Bending Machine Indonesia

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Field Service Engineer bertanggung jawab melakukan instalasi, commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance, perbaikan, dan pelayanan teknis terhadap mesin-mesin industri yang dipasarkan oleh PT. SLT Laser Bending Machine Indonesia, khususnya mesin Laser Cutting, CNC Press Brake/Bending, Laser Welding, Laser Tube Cutting, Laser Marking, dan mesin fabrikasi lainnya.

Tugas & Tanggung Jawab

  • Melakukan instalasi dan commissioning mesin di lokasi customer.

  • Melakukan pengecekan kondisi mesin sebelum dan setelah instalasi.

  • Melakukan setting, adjustment, dan calibration mesin agar dapat beroperasi sesuai spesifikasi.

  • Melakukan troubleshooting terhadap masalah mekanik, elektrik, pneumatic, hydraulic, control system, dan software mesin.

  • Melakukan preventive maintenance dan corrective maintenance.

  • Melakukan pemeriksaan dan penggantian spare part apabila diperlukan.

  • Memberikan training kepada operator/customer mengenai pengoperasian dan perawatan mesin.

  • Memberikan support teknis kepada customer melalui onsite maupun remote support.

  • Melakukan analisa kerusakan dan membuat laporan hasil service.

  • Melakukan follow-up terhadap masalah customer sampai mesin kembali beroperasi dengan normal.

  • Berkoordinasi dengan tim Sales, Engineering, Spare Part, dan Management dalam menangani kebutuhan customer.

  • Membantu melakukan testing mesin sebelum pengiriman maupun setelah mesin tiba di lokasi customer.

  • Membaca dan memahami electrical drawing, mechanical drawing, pneumatic/hydraulic diagram, serta manual mesin.

  • Melakukan komunikasi teknis dengan supplier/principal apabila terdapat masalah yang membutuhkan support lebih lanjut.

  • Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas ke berbagai wilayah Indonesia sesuai kebutuhan customer.

  • Menjaga hubungan profesional dengan customer serta memberikan pelayanan after-sales service yang baik.

  • Menjaga peralatan kerja, tools, spare part, dan aset perusahaan yang digunakan selama pekerjaan.

Kualifikasi

  • Pendidikan minimal SMK/D3/S1 Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, Mekatronika, atau bidang terkait.

  • Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Field Service Engineer, Service Engineer, Maintenance Engineer, Technician, atau posisi sejenis lebih diutamakan.

  • Memiliki pengalaman menangani mesin industri/fabrikasi menjadi nilai tambah.

  • Memahami dasar mekanik dan elektrik.

  • Memahami PLC, inverter/servo, sensor, motor, pneumatic, hydraulic, dan sistem kontrol menjadi nilai tambah.

  • Mampu membaca electrical diagram dan mechanical drawing.

  • Mampu menggunakan alat ukur dan tools teknis.

  • Mampu melakukan troubleshooting secara sistematis.

  • Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.

  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dengan customer.

  • Bersedia bekerja mobile dan melakukan perjalanan dinas ke luar kota.

  • Memiliki SIM A/C menjadi nilai tambah.

  • Disiplin, bertanggung jawab, cepat belajar, memiliki inisiatif, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan.

  • Pengalaman menangani Laser Cutting Machine, CNC Press Brake, Laser Welding, atau mesin fabrikasi logam sangat diutamakan.

Target / KPI

  • Kecepatan dan ketepatan penyelesaian masalah customer.

  • Keberhasilan instalasi dan commissioning mesin.

  • Tingkat kepuasan customer.

  • Kecepatan response terhadap keluhan customer.

  • Ketepatan laporan service.

  • Minimnya repeat problem akibat kesalahan troubleshooting.

  • Kedisiplinan dalam menjalankan preventive maintenance dan service schedule.

Benefit

  • Gaji kompetitif sesuai pengalaman dan kemampuan.

  • Uang makan dan transportasi sesuai kebijakan perusahaan.

  • Uang perjalanan dinas.

  • Insentif/bonus berdasarkan kinerja.

  • Training teknis mengenai mesin dan teknologi terbaru.

  • Kesempatan berkembang menjadi Senior Service Engineer / Technical Supervisor.

  • Lingkungan kerja profesional di bidang mesin industri dan fabrikasi.

Penempatan

Cikarang Pusat, Jawa Barat

Catatan: Kandidat yang memiliki pengalaman menangani mesin laser cutting, CNC bending/press brake, laser welding, atau mesin industri fabrikasi akan menjadi prioritas.

jobs.description: About the role We are seeking a driven and ambitious Product Designer to join our team at PT Lampbond Indonesia in Benda Banten. This is a full-time work opportunity that will provide you with hands-on experience in product management and development within a dynamic and innovative company. As a Product Designer, you will play a crucial role in shaping the future of our products and contributing to the overall success of the business. What you'll be doing Assist in the development and refinement of new product ideas and concepts Conduct market research and gather customer insights to inform product strategy Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and prototype new product features Participate in the testing and evaluation of product prototypes Contribute to the development of product roadmaps and launch plans Identify opportunities for product improvements and enhancements Support the implementation of product updates and changes What we're looking for Having a degree in Marketing, Business, Product Management, or a related field Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team Familiarity with product development methodologies and design principles A passion for understanding customer needs and delivering exceptional products Adaptability and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment What we offer At PT Lampbond Indonesia, we are committed to providing our employees with a rewarding and enriching experience. As a Product Designer, you will have the opportunity to gain valuable hands-on experience, develop your skills, and collaborate with a talented team of professionals. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities for career development, and a supportive work environment that fosters innovation and growth. About us PT Lampbond Indonesia is a leading provider of innovative products and solutions in the lighting industry. Our mission is to revolutionize the way businesses and consumers interact with our products. With a strong focus on our philosophy Beyond Light , we are continuously investing in research and development to deliver cutting-edge solutions that exceed our customers' expectations. If you are excited about the prospect of joining our dynamic team and contributing to the growth of our business, we encourage you to apply now.

jobs.title: Recruitment & People Development Manager
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari seorang Recruitment & People Development Manager yang mampu membangun dan mengelola sistem Talent Management secara end-to-end, mulai dari talent strategy, workforce planning, talent acquisition, competency, performance, talent assessment, development, career, succession, culture, retention, hingga people analytics. Tanggung Jawab Utama Menyusun dan menjalankan strategi Talent Management sesuai kebutuhan bisnis. Mengelola talent mapping, competency, performance, dan potential assessment. Mengembangkan program Talent Development dan Leadership Development. Menyusun career path, succession plan, dan talent pipeline. Menguatkan company values, culture, engagement, dan talent retention. Mengembangkan employer branding dan talent attraction. Melakukan evaluasi program menggunakan data dan insight HR. Berkolaborasi dengan Management dan Department Head dalam pengembangan talent dan organisasi. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal S1 Psikologi, Manajemen, HR, atau bidang terkait. Berpengalaman level manager 3 tahun untuk posisi Talent Management, Talent Development, OD, atau HR terkait Pengalaman di perusahaan logistik & transportasi / teknologi & informasi sangat direkomendasikan Memahami strategi recruitment, competency management, talent mapping, performance, development, career, dan succession planning. Memiliki kemampuan analitis, strategis, komunikasi, dan stakeholder management yang baik. Terbiasa mengelola program atau proyek HR dan menggunakan data untuk evaluasi serta pengambilan keputusan. Bersedia penempatan mobile di Wiyung (Surabaya) dan Balongbendo (sidoarjo) Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji pokok yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan pengalaman serta performa kerja. Tunjangan kesehatan, ketenagakerjaan, bonus tahunan, cuti tahunan, THR Peluang pengembangan karier. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional dan mendukung dengan budaya kerja yang kolaboratif. Akses ke fasilitas dan infrastruktur operasional modern untuk menunjang performa kerja. Kesempatan untuk bekerja pada perusahaan yang berkembang pesat dalam industri logistik & teknologi modern.

Gaji kompetitif, bonus kinerja, & pengembangan karier jelas.", "content2": "

Kesempatan
Kami mencari seorang Recruitment & People Development Manager yang mampu membangun dan mengelola sistem Talent Management secara end-to-end, mulai dari talent strategy, workforce planning, talent acquisition, competency, performance, talent assessment, development, career, succession, culture, retention, hingga people analytics.


Tanggung Jawab Utama

  • Menyusun dan menjalankan strategi Talent Management sesuai kebutuhan bisnis.

  • Mengelola talent mapping, competency, performance, dan potential assessment.

  • Mengembangkan program Talent Development dan Leadership Development.

  • Menyusun career path, succession plan, dan talent pipeline.

  • Menguatkan company values, culture, engagement, dan talent retention.

  • Mengembangkan employer branding dan talent attraction.

  • Melakukan evaluasi program menggunakan data dan insight HR.

  • Berkolaborasi dengan Management dan Department Head dalam pengembangan talent dan organisasi.


Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan

  • Minimal S1 Psikologi, Manajemen, HR, atau bidang terkait.

  • Berpengalaman level manager 3 tahun untuk posisi Talent Management, Talent Development, OD, atau HR terkait

  • Pengalaman di perusahaan logistik & transportasi / teknologi & informasi sangat direkomendasikan

  • Memahami strategi recruitment, competency management, talent mapping, performance, development, career, dan succession planning.

  • Memiliki kemampuan analitis, strategis, komunikasi, dan stakeholder management yang baik.

  • Terbiasa mengelola program atau proyek HR dan menggunakan data untuk evaluasi serta pengambilan keputusan.

  • Bersedia penempatan mobile di Wiyung (Surabaya) dan Balongbendo (sidoarjo)


Manfaat Utama Perusahaan

  • Gaji pokok yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan pengalaman serta performa kerja.

  • Tunjangan kesehatan, ketenagakerjaan, bonus tahunan, cuti tahunan, THR

  • Peluang pengembangan karier.

  • Lingkungan kerja yang profesional dan mendukung dengan budaya kerja yang kolaboratif.

  • Akses ke fasilitas dan infrastruktur operasional modern untuk menunjang performa kerja.

  • Kesempatan untuk bekerja pada perusahaan yang berkembang pesat dalam industri logistik & teknologi modern.

About you

  • Experience with Shopify website management

  • Technical support and troubleshooting capabilities for hardware and software issues

  • Experience managing IT equipment and devices

  • Knowledge of hardware diagnostics, software installation, configuration, and updates

  • Ability to troubleshoot operating system, application, network connectivity, and user-access issues

  • Experience with MikroTik RouterOS and network infrastructure implementation

  • Ability to configure IP addressing, network segmentation, and access policies

  • Experience with Wi-Fi coverage testing and network optimization

jobs.title: Staff Officer HR
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT Indo World' mencari Staff Officer HR yang berdedikasi dan terorganisir untuk bergabung dengan tim Sumber Daya Manusia kami di Ngoro, Kabupaten Mojokerto, Jawa Timur. Sebagai Staff Officer HR, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mendukung fungsi administratif dan operasional departemen HR untuk memastikan kelancaran proses manajemen sumber daya manusia di seluruh organisasi. Posisi ini merupakan peran full-time yang membutuhkan profesional yang detail-oriented, komunikatif, dan mampu mengelola berbagai tugas administratif dengan efisien. Jabatan ini menawarkan kesempatan untuk berkembang dalam industri manajemen sumber daya manusia sambil berkontribusi langsung pada kesuksesan perusahaan. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola dokumentasi dan arsip karyawan dengan terorganisir, memastikan semua data HR tersimpan dengan aman dan mudah diakses sesuai dengan kebijakan perusahaan dan peraturan yang berlaku. Mendukung pengelolaan data karyawan, termasuk pencatatan kehadiran, cuti, dan informasi kepegawaian lainnya. Membantu dalam penyelenggaraan program HR seperti acara perusahaan. Menangani korespondensi administratif dan komunikasi internal dengan departemen lain. Menyiapkan laporan HR rutin dan statistik kepegawaian untuk manajemen. Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap peraturan ketenagakerjaan dan kebijakan perusahaan. Mampu bekerja secara over time (terhitung). Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Diploma atau Sarjana dalam bidang Manajemen Sumber Daya Manusia, Administrasi, Bisnis, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman di bidang HR, administrasi, atau dukungan kantor sejenis. Penguasaan MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) dan sistem manajemen data karyawan. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik secara lisan maupun tertulis, dalam bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris dasar. Keterampilan organisasi dan manajemen waktu yang sangat baik untuk menangani berbagai tugas secara bersamaan. Tingkat ketelitian dalam mengerjakan termasuk yang utama. Pemahaman tentang hukum ketenagakerjaan dan peraturan HR di Indonesia. Kemampuan untuk menjaga kerahasiaan dan integritas informasi karyawan. Perhatian terhadap detail dan akurasi dalam pekerjaan administratif. Bersikap profesional, ramah, dan dapat bekerja sama dalam lingkungan tim. Manfaat Utama Bekerja di PT Indo World' Gaji dan tunjangan yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan kualifikasi. Jaminan Sosial Tenaga Kerja (BPJS Kesehatan dan BPJS Ketenagakerjaan) untuk karyawan dan keluarga. Tunjangan kesehatan dan asuransi tambahan untuk kesejahteraan Anda. Cuti tahunan yang disesuaikan dengan peraturan perburuhan Indonesia. Kesempatan pengembangan karier dan pelatihan profesional berkelanjutan. Lingkungan kerja yang aman, mendukung, dan kolaboratif. Peluang untuk berkembang dalam industri manajemen sumber daya manusia yang dinamis. Tentang PT Indo World' PT Indo World' adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan dan solusi terbaik kepada stakeholder kami. Dengan lokasi di Ngoro, Kabupaten Mojokerto, Jawa Timur, kami terus berkembang dan berinovasi untuk memenuhi kebutuhan pasar yang dinamis. jobs.title: Cook helper
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Cook Helper yang berdedikasi dan bersemangat untuk bergabung dengan tim dapur Hutanika' di Bandung, Jawa Barat. Sebagai Cook Helper, Anda akan menjadi bagian integral dari operasi dapur kami, mendukung chef dan cook berpengalaman dalam mempersiapkan hidangan berkualitas tinggi. Posisi ini merupakan peran waktu penuh yang menawarkan kesempatan pembelajaran langsung dalam industri perhotelan dan pariwisata. Jabatan ini ideal bagi individu yang antusias tentang kuliner, memiliki etos kerja yang kuat, dan siap untuk berkembang dalam lingkungan dapur yang dinamis. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mempersiapkan bahan-bahan makanan termasuk mencuci, mengupas, dan memotong sayuran, daging, dan bahan lainnya sesuai dengan standar dapur. Membantu chef dan cook dalam proses memasak dan penyajian hidangan. Menjaga kebersihan dan ketertiban area dapur, peralatan, dan meja kerja sesuai dengan protokol sanitasi dan keselamatan makanan. Mengorganisir dan menyimpan bahan makanan dengan benar di area penyimpanan yang sesuai. Membantu dalam penghitungan inventaris bahan makanan dan pelaporan kebutuhan dapur. Mendukung tim dalam memenuhi pesanan dengan cepat dan efisien selama waktu layanan sibuk. Mematuhi semua prosedur keselamatan kerja dan kebersihan di dapur. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal SMP/SMA atau setara, dengan pengalaman di bidang kuliner menjadi nilai tambah. Pengalaman bekerja di dapur restoran, hotel, atau fasilitas food service minimal 1-2 tahun. Pemahaman tentang kebersihan dan keselamatan makanan serta protokol sanitasi dapur. Kemampuan untuk bekerja dalam tim dan menerima instruksi dengan baik dari chef dan cook senior. Kesabaran, ketelitian, dan perhatian terhadap detail dalam persiapan makanan. Fisik yang kuat dan stamina untuk bekerja dalam lingkungan dapur yang panas dan sibuk. Kemampuan untuk bekerja di bawah tekanan dan mengelola pekerjaan dalam waktu terbatas. Komunikasi yang baik dan sikap yang profesional. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif dan tunjangan sesuai dengan peraturan ketenagakerjaan. Pelatihan dan pengembangan keterampilan kuliner dari chef berpengalaman. Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung dan tim yang solid. Peluang pengembangan karier menuju posisi yang lebih tinggi di dapur. Asuransi kesehatan dan perlindungan sosial untuk karyawan. Makanan gratis atau subsidi selama bekerja. Jadwal kerja yang jelas dengan hari istirahat reguler. Program kesejahteraan karyawan untuk mendukung keseimbangan kehidupan kerja. Tentang Kami Hutanika' adalah hospitality establishment yang berdedikasi untuk memberikan pengalaman terbaik kepada tamu kami melalui pelayanan prima dan hidangan berkualitas tinggi. Berlokasi di Bandung, Jawa Barat, kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, profesional, dan mendukung pertumbuhan karyawan. Kami percaya bahwa setiap anggota tim, termasuk Cook Helper, memiliki peran penting dalam kesuksesan bisnis kami. Budaya kami menekankan keunggulan, integritas, dan passion untuk industri perhotelan dan pariwisata. Kami menyambut individu dari berbagai latar belakang dan menawarkan kesempatan yang setara bagi semua kandidat. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki semangat untuk industri kuliner dan ingin memulai perjalanan karier Anda di Hutanika', kami ingin mendengar dari Anda! Lamar sekarang dan jadilah bagian dari tim kami yang dinamis dan profesional.

jobs.description: Job Desk Mencari, mengembangkan, dan menjalin kerja sama dengan perusahaan, komunitas, travel agent, hotel, penyelenggara event, serta mitra potensial lainnya. Memasarkan layanan perusahaan yang meliputi layanan driver, tour & guide, serta kerja sama event. Melakukan presentasi, negosiasi, dan follow up kepada calon maupun pelanggan aktif. Membangun dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan pelanggan serta mitra bisnis. Mencapai target penjualan yang telah ditetapkan perusahaan. Berkoordinasi dengan tim operasional untuk memastikan kebutuhan pelanggan terpenuhi. Membuat laporan aktivitas penjualan dan perkembangan kerja sama secara berkala. Kualifikasi Asli BALI / Domisili BALI, bisa join secepatnya Minimal pendidikan SMA/SMK, diutamakan D3/S1 semua jurusan. Memiliki pengalaman di bidang sales/marketing menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, presentasi, dan negosiasi yang baik. Berorientasi pada target, proaktif, serta mampu bekerja secara individu maupun tim. Memiliki kemampuan membangun relasi dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan klien. Menguasai Microsoft Office dan media sosial sebagai sarana pemasaran. Memiliki jaringan di bidang transportasi, pariwisata, atau event organizer menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki SIM A/C dan kendaraan pribadi menjadi nilai tambah untuk mendukung mobilitas kerja.

jobs.title: Full Time Accounting (WFH/HYBRID)
jobs.description: About the role Step Forward Lombok is seeking a dedicated Full Time Accounting professional to join our finance team in Central Lombok, West Nusa Tenggara. This is a hybrid/work-from-home opportunity that offers flexibility whilst maintaining strong team collaboration. In this role, you will be responsible for managing financial accounting and reporting functions that are essential to our operational and strategic objectives. You will play a vital part in ensuring accurate financial records, compliance with accounting standards, and the delivery of timely financial information to support decision-making across the organisation. Key responsibilities Prepare and maintain accurate financial records, including journal entries, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger management Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with relevant accounting standards and regulatory requirements Reconcile bank statements, balance sheet accounts, and other financial records to ensure accuracy and completeness Support the audit process by preparing documentation, schedules, and reconciliations as required Monitor and record financial transactions, ensuring proper classification and coding Assist with the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and financial analyses to support management decisions Maintain organised financial records and documentation in compliance with company policies and legal requirements Identify and communicate discrepancies or irregularities in financial data promptly Collaborate with other finance team members to streamline processes and improve efficiency Stay current with changes in accounting standards, tax regulations, and best practices in the industry What we're looking for Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in financial record-keeping Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines Good communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain financial information to non-finance stakeholders Ability to work independently whilst remaining collaborative and supportive of team objectives Knowledge of tax compliance and reporting requirements is advantageous Experience with remote or hybrid working arrangements and self-motivation are desirable What we offer Step Forward Lombok is committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace environment. We offer a range of benefits designed to support your professional development and wellbeing: Flexible hybrid and work-from-home arrangements that enable a healthy work-life balance Competitive remuneration packages commensurate with experience and qualifications Ongoing professional development opportunities, including training in accounting standards and software systems Access to a supportive team culture that values collaboration, integrity, and continuous improvement A role that offers exposure to diverse accounting functions and opportunities to expand your skill set Reasonable accommodations and support for employees with specific needs About us Stepforward Lombok is a business management company dedicated to helping businesses operate more efficiently, professionally, and sustainably. We provide integrated business solutions across three core services: Human Resources, Accounting, and Tax. Our approach focuses on simplifying business operations, improving financial management, and building strong and reliable teams. We work closely with our clients to provide practical solutions that support their day-to-day operations and long-term business growth. . Apply now If you are a qualified accounting professional seeking a flexible, hybrid role with a purpose-driven organisation, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a covering letter outlining your relevant experience, and any professional certifications. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive recruitment process. Should you require any adjustments or support during the application process, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Grow your accounting career with a purpose-driven organisation.", "content2": "

About the role

Step Forward Lombok is seeking a dedicated Full Time Accounting professional to join our finance team in Central Lombok, West Nusa Tenggara. This is a hybrid/work-from-home opportunity that offers flexibility whilst maintaining strong team collaboration. In this role, you will be responsible for managing financial accounting and reporting functions that are essential to our operational and strategic objectives. You will play a vital part in ensuring accurate financial records, compliance with accounting standards, and the delivery of timely financial information to support decision-making across the organisation.

Key responsibilities

  • Prepare and maintain accurate financial records, including journal entries, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger management

  • Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with relevant accounting standards and regulatory requirements

  • Reconcile bank statements, balance sheet accounts, and other financial records to ensure accuracy and completeness

  • Support the audit process by preparing documentation, schedules, and reconciliations as required

  • Monitor and record financial transactions, ensuring proper classification and coding

  • Assist with the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and financial analyses to support management decisions

  • Maintain organised financial records and documentation in compliance with company policies and legal requirements

  • Identify and communicate discrepancies or irregularities in financial data promptly

  • Collaborate with other finance team members to streamline processes and improve efficiency

  • Stay current with changes in accounting standards, tax regulations, and best practices in the industry


What we're looking for

  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in financial record-keeping

  • Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines

  • Good communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain financial information to non-finance stakeholders

  • Ability to work independently whilst remaining collaborative and supportive of team objectives

  • Knowledge of tax compliance and reporting requirements is advantageous

  • Experience with remote or hybrid working arrangements and self-motivation are desirable


What we offer

Step Forward Lombok is committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace environment. We offer a range of benefits designed to support your professional development and wellbeing:

  • Flexible hybrid and work-from-home arrangements that enable a healthy work-life balance

  • Competitive remuneration packages commensurate with experience and qualifications

  • Ongoing professional development opportunities, including training in accounting standards and software systems

  • Access to a supportive team culture that values collaboration, integrity, and continuous improvement

  • A role that offers exposure to diverse accounting functions and opportunities to expand your skill set

  • Reasonable accommodations and support for employees with specific needs


About us

Stepforward Lombok is a business management company dedicated to helping businesses operate more efficiently, professionally, and sustainably. We provide integrated business solutions across three core services: Human Resources, Accounting, and Tax. Our approach focuses on simplifying business operations, improving financial management, and building strong and reliable teams. We work closely with our clients to provide practical solutions that support their day-to-day operations and long-term business growth..

Apply now

If you are a qualified accounting professional seeking a flexible, hybrid role with a purpose-driven organisation, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a covering letter outlining your relevant experience, and any professional certifications. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive recruitment process. Should you require any adjustments or support during the application process, please do not hesitate to contact us.

jobs.description: ### WE ARE HIRING: IN-HOUSE LEGAL COUNSEL (LITIGATION & CORPORATE HYBRID) Location: Denpasar, Bali Employment Type: Full-Time (PKWT) Compensation: IDR 10,000,000 Base Salary + Performance/Litigation Success Bonus About Us: As we expand our operations, we are seeking a sharp, versatile, and court-ready In-House Lawyer to protect our commercial interests, manage corporate compliance, and directly handle dispute resolutions. The Role (Hybrid Profile): Unlike traditional corporate legal roles, we require a hybrid professional. You will act as the company's internal corporate shield (managing contracts and regulatory affairs) and its sword in the courtroom (handling active litigation under your own license). Key Responsibilities: - Represent the PMA directly in civil, criminal, or administrative court proceedings and alternative dispute resolution (ADR). - Draft, review, and negotiate high-value commercial leases, vendor contracts, and joint ventures in English and Indonesian. - Manage full corporate compliance, including quarterly Investment Activity Reports (LKPM) via the OSS RBA system. - Mitigate operational risks by providing strategic, localized legal counsel regarding Bali's land regulations and customary law (Hukum Adat/Banjar) dynamics. Requirements: - Bachelor of Laws (S.H.) from a reputable university. - MUST hold an active PERADI Advocate Membership Card (KTA) and possess the Advocate Oath Deed (Berita Acara Sumpah - BAS). - Minimum of 3–5 years of active experience in litigation (drafting Gugatan, Jawaban, Somasi, and handling court trials). - Solid understanding of PMA corporate procedures, BKPM regulations, and contract law. - Professional fluency in written and spoken English is a plus. - Currently residing in Bali or prepared for immediate relocation. Benefits: - Competitive Starting Base Salary of IDR 10,000,000. - Performance-driven bonuses tied to regulatory milestones and an attractive Success bonus per successfully managed court/dispute case. - BPJS Kesehatan & BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. - Full corporate funding/reimbursement for all official court operational expenses (Biaya Panjar, E-Court, etc.). - Hybrid : can work remotely most of the time

### WE ARE HIRING: IN-HOUSE LEGAL COUNSEL (LITIGATION & CORPORATE HYBRID)

Location: Denpasar, Bali

Employment Type: Full-Time (PKWT)

Compensation: IDR 10,000,000 Base Salary + Performance/Litigation Success Bonus

 

About Us:

As we expand our operations, we are seeking a sharp, versatile, and court-ready In-House Lawyer to protect our commercial interests, manage corporate compliance, and directly handle dispute resolutions.

 

The Role (Hybrid Profile):

Unlike traditional corporate legal roles, we require a hybrid professional. You will act as the company's internal corporate shield (managing contracts and regulatory affairs) and its sword in the courtroom (handling active litigation under your own license).

 

Key Responsibilities:

- Represent the PMA directly in civil, criminal, or administrative court proceedings and alternative dispute resolution (ADR).

- Draft, review, and negotiate high-value commercial leases, vendor contracts, and joint ventures in English and Indonesian.

- Manage full corporate compliance, including quarterly Investment Activity Reports (LKPM) via the OSS RBA system.

- Mitigate operational risks by providing strategic, localized legal counsel regarding Bali's land regulations and customary law (Hukum Adat/Banjar) dynamics.

 

Requirements:

- Bachelor of Laws (S.H.) from a reputable university.

- MUST hold an active PERADI Advocate Membership Card (KTA) and possess the Advocate Oath Deed (Berita Acara Sumpah - BAS).

- Minimum of 3–5 years of active experience in litigation (drafting Gugatan, Jawaban, Somasi, and handling court trials).

- Solid understanding of PMA corporate procedures, BKPM regulations, and contract law.

- Professional fluency in written and spoken English is a plus.

- Currently residing in Bali or prepared for immediate relocation.

 

Benefits:

- Competitive Starting Base Salary of IDR 10,000,000.

- Performance-driven bonuses tied to regulatory milestones and an attractive Success bonus per successfully managed court/dispute case.

- BPJS Kesehatan & BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.

- Full corporate funding/reimbursement for all official court operational expenses (Biaya Panjar, E-Court, etc.).

- Hybrid : can work remotely most of the time

jobs.title: Operator Quality Control
jobs.company: PT Surya Biru Murni Acetylene Tbk
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Operator Quality Control yang terampil dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim Quality Control di PT Surya Biru Murni Acetylene Tbk. Dalam posisi ini, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam memastikan bahwa semua produk memenuhi standar kualitas tertinggi sebelum mencapai pelanggan. Sebagai Operator Quality Control, Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk melakukan pengujian komprehensif, inspeksi, dan verifikasi produk di seluruh proses produksi. Posisi ini menawarkan kesempatan untuk berkontribusi langsung pada keunggulan operasional perusahaan dan memastikan kepuasan pelanggan yang konsisten. Ini adalah posisi full-time yang berlokasi di East Balikpapan, East Kalimantan , di mana Anda akan bekerja di fasilitas produksi kami yang modern. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal pendidikan SMA/SMK Pengalaman minimal 2-3 tahun sebagai Operator Quality Control atau posisi terkait di industri manufaktur atau lingkungan produksi. Fresh graduate dipersilahkan melamar. Pemahaman yang kuat tentang standar kontrol kualitas, prosedur inspeksi, dan dokumentasi produk. Kemampuan untuk membaca dan menginterpretasikan spesifikasi teknis, gambar produk, dan standar kualitas dengan akurat. Keahlian dalam menggunakan peralatan pengujian kualitas standar industri dan instrumen pengukuran presisi. Pengetahuan dasar mengenai sistem manajemen kualitas (QMS) dan standar ISO yang relevan. Kemampuan analitik yang kuat dengan perhatian terhadap detail yang cermat dalam mengidentifikasi produk. Keterampilan komunikasi yang baik dan kemampuan untuk berkolaborasi efektif dengan tim multidisiplin. Disiplin tinggi, inisiatif, dan komitmen terhadap keunggulan dan keselamatan kerja. Pemahaman dasar tentang persyaratan kesehatan, keselamatan, dan lingkungan (HSE) di industri manufaktur. Pengalaman dengan sistem pencatatan data digital atau spreadsheet (Excel) dianggap sebagai nilai tambah. Bersedia bekerja dalam shift. Diutamakan berdomisili di Balikpapan. Tentang Kami PT Surya Biru Murni Acetylene Tbk: Produsen gas terkemuka selama lebih dari 40 tahun, dengan jaringan luas dan teknologi mutakhir. Kami hadirkan gas industri berkualitas dan layanan pelanggan terbaik. Ajakan untuk Melamar Jika Anda memiliki keterampilan dan pengalaman yang kami cari, serta bersemangat untuk berkontribusi pada tim quality control kami yang dinamis, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang . Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan dokumen pendukung lainnya melalui portal karir kami atau hubungi tim Human Resources PT Surya Biru Murni Acetylene Tbk untuk informasi lebih lanjut.

jobs.title: MPInTech - Medela Potentia Internship Technology
jobs.description: MPInTech (Medela Potentia Internship Technology) adalah program magang strategis 6 bulan dari PT Medela Potentia Tbk untuk mencetak talenta digital ready-to-work. Metode yang diterapkan adalah Blended Learning (modul adaptif & hands-on real projects), ditujukan khusus bagi mahasiswa/i dari universitas unggulan. Kualifikasi Umum: Mahasiswa tingkat akhir atau Fresh Graduate dari jurusan IT, Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, Statistika, dsb. Memiliki passion pada continuous learning dan tren teknologi terkini. Bersedia on-site working (WFO) penuh waktu di Bintaro, Tangerang Selatan . Posisi yang Dibuka & Key Responsibilities: Data Scientist AI (Intern) Melakukan riset dan analisis data harian melalui pendekatan vibecoding bersama AI, dengan fokus utama pada pembuatan AI Agent untuk mendukung operasional internal dan menghasilkan business insights. Data Engineer (Intern) Mendukung perancangan dan maintenance arsitektur pipeline data, serta mengeksekusi otomatisasi proses Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) beserta manajemen database. Apa yang Akan Didapatkan? Allowance : Uang saku bulanan selama program berlangsung. Real Project Experience : Keterlibatan langsung pada proyek nyata. Exclusive Mentoring : Sesi training dan pendampingan oleh Instructor beserta tim. Certificate: Sertifikat resmi di akhir program sebagai bukti pengalaman profesional.

jobs.title: Mid Fullstack Developer
jobs.description: About the Role We are looking for a Mid Fullstack Developer to take real ownership across our engineering stack, from proposing architecture and design decisions through to debugging issues in live production environments. This is not a role that only implements what is specified. You will weigh trade-offs, propose solutions, and help decide how our systems are built. In practice, that means working end to end across our React and Next.js front end, our Node.js, Fastify, Java Spring-boot, and Go services, and the cloud environments we deploy to, while reviewing code, mentoring junior developers, and working directly with clients and stakeholders to clarify requirements. What You Will Be Doing • Translate design specifications and business workflows into readable, maintainable, and well-architected code. • Investigate, design, test, apply, and evaluate new or existing technologies, and recommend improvements to the team. • Write and modify code that is scalable, performant, resilient, and well-documented, while helping enforce coding standards across the team. • Maintain and upgrade existing systems, ensuring proper training and documentation are provided to users. • Deploy and manage test and development environments, ensuring consistency and identifying discrepancies before they reach production. • Report on weekly tasks and progress using project management tools such as JIRA, Airtable, ClickUp, Microsoft Office, Google Docs/Sheets/Slides, Trello, and Bitbucket. • Own documentation efforts, including technical installation guides, administration manuals, code usage references, application configuration guides, and training materials. • Contribute to improving team processes, tooling, or documentation standards. • Lead discussions on engineering issues and trade-offs, contributing sound technical judgment to the team. • Collaborate closely with engineers, designers, and clients, and provide guidance to junior developers when needed. What We Are Looking For Education and experience • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with a minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant experience. Technical skills • Proven experience in front-end development using JavaScript and TypeScript, with strong proficiency in React and Next.js (knowledge of Vue.js, Astro, or Svelte is a plus). • Proven experience in back-end development using Node.js, Fastify, and Go (knowledge of Java/Spring Boot is a plus). • Practical experience deploying and managing applications in cloud environments, particularly AWS, Azure, DigitalOcean, and Vercel. • Strong understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, such as SQL Server, SingleStore, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, CouchDB, Cassandra, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and Redis, including schema design and query optimization. • Solid experience with unit testing, security remediation, and non-functional testing. • Working knowledge of DevSecOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, orchestration, and containerization. • Practical experience with test-driven development (TDD) and applying security concepts for prevention and detection. • Hands-on experience with automated testing using Jest, Playwright, TestNG, and/or Cypress. • Comfortable working in Linux environments (Ubuntu/RedHat). Process and tools • Experienced in Agile workflows and tools such as JIRA, Airtable, ClickUp, Github, Microsoft Office, Google Docs/Sheets/Slides, Trello, and Bitbucket, with a strong focus on continuous improvement and software craftsmanship. How you work • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. • Ownership over architecture/design decisions, not just implementing specs, but proposing solutions and weighing trade-offs. • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, only escalating genuinely complex or ambiguous problems. • Code review responsibility, reviewing peers' or juniors' code, not just having their own review. • Mentorship, guiding junior developers, pairing, or helping onboard new hires. • Estimation/scoping skills, able to break down features and give realistic time/effort estimates. • Production ownership, comfortable debugging/troubleshooting issues in live environments, not just dev/test. • Cross-functional communication, direct interaction with clients/stakeholders to clarify requirements, not just receiving fully-defined tasks.

jobs.title: Junior Fullstack Developer
jobs.description: About the Role We are looking for a Junior Developer to build real features on real systems, with senior engineers alongside you. You will write code that ships to enterprise clients, and you will have your work reviewed properly, which is the fastest way we know to get good. You will work across the stack, from the React and Next.js front end through to our Node.js, Fastify, and Go services, and you will be expected to ask questions, raise concerns, and say when something does not make sense. Why You Will Want to Join • You will learn on real systems. Not sandbox projects. Your code runs in production for clients who depend on it, which teaches you things no tutorial can. • Every line you write gets reviewed. Senior engineers read your code and explain the why, not just the what. Mentoring is part of the job here, not a favour. • A stack that will still be worth knowing in five years. TypeScript, React and Next.js, Go, cloud deployments, CI/CD, and proper testing habits from day one. What You Will Be Doing • Translate UI and UX designs into readable, maintainable code. • Investigate, design, test, apply, and evaluate new or existing code. • Write and modify code that complies with our standards and is scalable, performant, resilient, and well documented. • Maintain and upgrade existing code, and help make sure users are given proper training. • Deploy test and development environments, and check that there are no code discrepancies between them. • Report on weekly tasks using project management tools such as JIRA, Airtable, ClickUp, Microsoft Office, Google Docs/Sheets/Slides, Trello, and Bitbucket. • Assist with documentation, including user installation, administration, code usage, application configuration manuals, and training materials. • Discuss engineering issues and trade-offs openly, and communicate clearly when you are stuck or unsure. • Collaborate with other engineers, design professionals, and clients to build systems and software. What We Are Looking For Education and experience • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. • Up to 2 years of professional experience. Strong personal projects, internships, or bootcamp work count. Technical skills • Front-end development with JavaScript and TypeScript, with working knowledge of React and Next.js. • Back-end development with Node.js, Fastify, and Go Fiber. • Some exposure to cloud environments, particularly DigitalOcean and Vercel. • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, SingleStore, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, CouchDB, Cassandra, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and Redis. • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, orchestration, and containerization. • Familiarity with test-driven development and with security concepts for prevention and detection. • Familiarity with automated testing using Jest and Cypress. • Familiarity with Linux environments (Ubuntu/RedHat). • Comfortable with Git and Bitbucket for version control and code review. Process and tools • Familiar with Agile environments and tools such as JIRA, Airtable, ClickUp, Microsoft Office, Google Docs/Sheets/Slides, Trello, and Bitbucket, with a focus on continuous improvement and software craftsmanship. How you work • Willing to ask questions early rather than stay stuck quietly. • Open to feedback on your code, and able to act on it without taking it personally. • Careful about details, and willing to read the specification before writing the code. • Eager to learn, and honest about what you do not know yet.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer to join a team that works in a spec-driven way. This is not a role that starts once the code is finished. You will be part of the delivery process from the first draft of a specification through to release, making sure that what we agreed, what we built, and what we verified all still line up. In practice, that means helping shape Functional Specification Documents (FSD) and writing Gherkin scenarios with acceptance criteria that leave little room for interpretation. You will verify what developers deliver across backend, frontend, and integration layers, review their code against our engineering standards, check the security and performance testing they have run, and then lead the full QA cycle before anything ships. How We Work Our delivery process is spec-driven and gated. Each stage has to be verified before the next one starts, and QA is the verifying party at every gate: • Planning: requirements are captured in an FSD and written as Gherkin scenarios with clear, testable acceptance criteria. • Development: developers build against the specification and write unit tests covering the agreed behaviour. • Specification verification: QA confirms that the implementation genuinely satisfies the FSD and acceptance criteria across backend, frontend, and integration layers. • Standards review: QA compares the delivered code against our internal engineering standards and practices. • Engineering process verification: developers run SAST, DAST, and performance testing. QA reviews the results and the coverage before sign-off. • QA testing cycle: QA runs functional, end-to-end, smoke, fuzzy, A/B, and non-functional testing before release. What You Will Be Doing 1. Specification and test design • Join requirement and FSD discussions from the planning stage, and push back on ambiguity before it reaches development. • Write and review Gherkin scenarios (Given / When / Then) that turn business requirements into behaviour anyone can test. • Define clear, measurable acceptance criteria for each feature, including edge cases, negative paths, and boundary conditions. • Spot delivery risks early through test planning, analysis, and realistic estimation of effort and resources. • Produce and maintain test plans, test cases, and traceability between requirements, scenarios, and coverage. 2. Verification against the specification • Confirm that delivered backend, frontend, and integration code actually satisfies the FSD and its acceptance criteria, not just that it runs without errors. • Review unit tests written by developers for coverage, correctness, and alignment with the agreed acceptance criteria. • Validate API contracts, data flows, and system interactions using tools such as Postman or JMeter. • Confirm behaviour across service boundaries, including event-driven and asynchronous workflows. • Raise gaps between specification and implementation as soon as you find them, and see them through to resolution with the developer responsible. 3. Engineering standards and process verification • Compare delivered code against our internal standard practices, covering structure, naming, error handling, logging, and maintainability. • Review findings from static and dynamic analysis tooling (SAST and DAST) such as Snyk, CodeQL, or Semgrep, and make sure they are addressed rather than quietly deferred. • Check the performance testing developers have run, including whether the scenarios are realistic, the thresholds are sensible, and the results have been read correctly. • Hold back sign-off when the evidence is incomplete, and write down clearly what is needed to close the gate. 4. The QA testing cycle • Design and run functional and end-to-end test suites for web and mobile applications. • Run smoke tests on each build to confirm it is worth taking into a deeper test cycle. • Carry out fuzz and negative testing to surface unhandled inputs, malformed payloads, and unexpected system states. • Run regression and integration testing to confirm that new work has not broken anything that already worked. • Handle non-functional testing (performance, load, stress, and security) and report results against agreed thresholds. • Work across both manual and automated testing, and grow automation coverage where it will keep paying off. 5. Defect management and collaboration • Track, document, and manage bugs, risks, and issues so that anyone can reproduce and understand them. • Classify defects by severity and impact, and give stakeholders an honest read on release risk. • Work with developers and cross-functional teams to trace issues back to root cause rather than patching the symptom. • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and vendors so that testing stays aligned with business requirements and delivery runs smoothly. 6. Continuous improvement • Bring ideas for improving our testing processes, tooling, and methods. • Maintain and extend automated test suites inside CI/CD pipelines so quality gates run continuously instead of by hand. • Explore AI-augmented and agentic testing workflows where they measurably cut effort or widen coverage. What We Are Looking For Education and experience • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. • 2 years minimum professional experience in software quality assurance engineering and testing. • Experience working inside a structured or specification-driven delivery process. Technical skills • Working knowledge of code enough to read, write, and debug test scripts and to review application code during verification. • Be able to use Git and configure MCP server/client to add more insight into your testing. • A solid grasp of testing methodologies: functional, regression, integration, smoke, and end-to-end. • Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cucumber, Selenium, Appium, Cypress, TestNG, or similar. • Experience writing and reviewing unit tests, and working with developers on unit-test coverage. • Confidence with API testing tools such as Postman or JMeter. • Experience with non-functional testing: performance, load, stress, and security. • Familiarity with static and dynamic code analysis tools for finding vulnerabilities and code-quality issues. • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and with wiring automated tests into them. Process and documentation • Able to write and review Functional Specification Documents, and to turn requirements into Gherkin scenarios and acceptance criteria. • Clear, precise writing. Your defect reports and verification results need to be reproducible and hard to misread. • Comfortable holding a quality gate and explaining the reasoning behind a sign-off decision. Nice to have • Exposure to AI-augmented or agentic testing tools and workflows. • Experience testing systems in regulated and enterprise environments such as audit, financial services, or government. • Familiarity with event-driven or asynchronous architectures. • Experience with fuzzy testing or property-based testing. How you work • Strong attention to detail, with a habit of anticipating problems and finding the edge cases other people miss. • Proactive and adaptable, and comfortable in a fast-moving environment. • Willing to question specifications, implementations, and assumptions, including your own.

•     Explore AI-augmented and agentic testing workflows where they measurably cut effort or widen coverage.

What We Are Looking For

Education and experience

•     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

•     2 years minimum professional experience in software quality assurance engineering and testing.

•     Experience working inside a structured or specification-driven delivery process.

Technical skills

•     Working knowledge of code enough to read, write, and debug test scripts and to review application code during verification.

•     Be able to use Git and configure MCP server/client to add more insight into your testing.

•     A solid grasp of testing methodologies: functional, regression, integration, smoke, and end-to-end.

•     Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cucumber, Selenium, Appium, Cypress, TestNG, or similar.

•     Experience writing and reviewing unit tests, and working with developers on unit-test coverage.

•     Confidence with API testing tools such as Postman or JMeter.

•     Experience with non-functional testing: performance, load, stress, and security.

•     Familiarity with static and dynamic code analysis tools for finding vulnerabilities and code-quality issues.

•     Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and with wiring automated tests into them.

Process and documentation

•     Able to write and review Functional Specification Documents, and to turn requirements into Gherkin scenarios and acceptance criteria.

•     Clear, precise writing. Your defect reports and verification results need to be reproducible and hard to misread.

•     Comfortable holding a quality gate and explaining the reasoning behind a sign-off decision.

Nice to have

•     Exposure to AI-augmented or agentic testing tools and workflows.

•     Experience testing systems in regulated and enterprise environments such as audit, financial services, or government.

•     Familiarity with event-driven or asynchronous architectures.

•     Experience with fuzzy testing or property-based testing.

How you work

•     Strong attention to detail, with a habit of anticipating problems and finding the edge cases other people miss.

•     Proactive and adaptable, and comfortable in a fast-moving environment.

•     Willing to question specifications, implementations, and assumptions, including your own.

jobs.title: Admin Finance AP EMKL
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan: Memeriksa kelengkapan dokumen invoice dari vendor EMKL. Memastikan kesesuaian invoice dengan dokumen pendukung transaksi. Mengecek kesesuaian tarif dengan kontrak atau price list yang berlaku. Memeriksa nomor DO, Job Order, kendaraan, container, tanggal, rute, dan jenis layanan. Memeriksa perhitungan jumlah tagihan dan memastikan tidak ada kesalahan nominal. Mengecek biaya tambahan seperti waiting time, demurrage, detention, tol, parkir, dan biaya lainnya. Memastikan biaya tambahan memiliki bukti dan approval yang sesuai. Melakukan pengecekan untuk mencegah double billing atau tagihan yang tidak sesuai. Melakukan klarifikasi kepada vendor atau bagian terkait apabila terdapat selisih atau ketidaksesuaian. Membuat rekap invoice yang sudah sesuai, pending, return, atau masih menunggu kelengkapan dokumen. Melakukan monitoring invoice yang masih outstanding sampai dokumen lengkap. Menyimpan dan mengarsipkan dokumen invoice beserta dokumen pendukung secara rapi. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal D3/D4/S1 Akuntansi Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang Account Payable, Accounting Memahami proses invoice checking dan verifikasi dokumen pembayaran. Memahami dokumen operasional EMKL/logistik seperti DO, Job Order, Surat Jalan, POD, dan invoice vendor. Teliti, detail, dan memiliki kemampuan analisa yang baik. Mahir mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel. Memiliki integritas, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan dapat menjaga kerahasiaan data perusahaan. Bersedia masuk kerja Senin-Sabtu

jobs.title: Admin HR (Mandarin Speaker）
jobs.description: Perincian tugas 岗位说明及职责描述: Menyusun laporan-laporan administrasi ketenagakerjaan karyawan Tiongkok untuk dilaporkan secara rutin (mingguan/bulanan) kepada Atasan. 编制中国籍员工的人事行政报告，并按周/月定期提交给上级。 Melakukan pengajuan OA terkait Permohonan Persetujuan Kerja, Laporan Anggaran, termasuk meneruskan Informasi/Surat Pemberitahuan penting dari Tsingshan atau IMIP agar diketahui para pimpinan perusahaan dan/atau karyawan Indonesia. 在OA系统中提交相关申请，如工作审批、费用报销，并转发来自Tsingshan或IMIP的重要信息/通知给公司领导及/或印尼员工。 Membantu penerjemahan dokumen internal seperti SOP, standar dan peraturan manajemen, Surat Keputusan Direksi serta dokumen krusial lainnya untuk diarsipkan dan/atau disebarluaskan kepada pihak-pihak terkait di dalam perusahaan. 协助翻译内部文件，如SOP、管理制度、董事会决议及其他重要文件，用于存档或在公司内部传达。 Berperan sebagai jembatan komunikasi dan memastikan informasi, perintah kerja atau kebijakan perusahaan/Pimpinan TKA tersampaikan secara tepat makna maupun tepat waktu kepada anggota tim HRD. 作为沟通桥梁，确保公司或外籍领导的工作指示、信息或政策能够准确、及时地传达给人事团队成员。 Kriteria 要求: 1. Pendidikan minimal S1 sederajat, jurusan Manajemen SDM, Administrasi Bisnis, Psikologi, Hukum dan sejenisnya 本科以上，专业要求为人力资源管理、工商管理、心理学、法学及相关专业 2. Mampu berbicara, mendengar, membaca dan menulis dalam bahasa Mandarin secara profesional 能够专业听说读写汉语 3. Memiliki sertifikat HSK 5 keatas diprioritaskan 具有汉语水平5级及以上证书者优先。 4. Mahir mengoperasikan komputer, minimal Microsoft Office 熟悉操作电脑，至少办公软件 5. Sehat jasmani dan rohani 身心健康 6. Memiliki pengalaman menangani administrasi 150-250 employee；具有 150–250名员工人事行政管理经验； 7. Teliti ( Detail-Oriented ) dan terampil mengelola waktu. 注重细节（Detail-Oriented），具备良好的时间管理能力。 8. People-Oriented (mampu menjalin hubungan baik dengan berbagai karakteristik orang). 以人为本，善于与不同性格和背景的人员建立良好的人际关系； 9. Terbiasa bekerja sama dalam tim dan berintegritas；具备良好的团队协作能力，工作认真负责并恪守职业诚信； 10. Agile dan resilien terhadap tekanan. 敏捷灵活，能够承受工作压力并具备良好的抗压能力。 11. Bersedia ditempatkan di Morowali, Sulawesi Tengah 愿意在中苏拉维西，莫罗瓦利上班 Gaji dan tunjangan 薪资待遇: 1. Total gaji bulanan 9 juta - 15 juta (semakin tinggi level skill bahasa maka semakin tinggi gajinya) 月综合收入9条-15条（语言技能等级越高则工资越高） 2. BPJS Kesehatan dan Ketenagakerjaan 健康与劳动保险 3. PPH 21 ditanggung perusahaan 所得税21由公司承担 4. Uang lembur dan THR 加班费与节日补贴 5. Tunjangan pulsa 话费补贴 Benefit 福利待遇： 1. Disediakan mess, tempat tidur dan perlengkapannya, 1 mess 3-4 orang, di dalam mess ada Wi-fi, AC, air panas dan kamar mandi dalam. 免费提供宿舍及床上用品，住宿一般3-4人间，房间内有 Wi-fi、空调、热水、独立卫生间。 2. Disediakan makan sehari 3 kali, air mineral 提供一天三餐、矿泉水 3. Roster cuti per 3 bulan selama 14 hari, tiket pesawat pulang pergi ditanggung oleh perusahaan, jika karyawan memilih untuk tidak mengambil cuti, akan mendapatkan tunjangan sebesar Rp 6.000.000,- 每三个月休假一次，每次14天，往返机票由公司承担，若员工放弃休假，可拿到6条印尼盾作为放弃休假补贴。 3. Pengobatan di klinik dan Medical Check Up tahunan gratis 免费在园区医院就诊与年度体检 4. Tiket pesawat waktu pertama kali bergabung bisa diklaim ke perusahaan 员工第一次进矿的飞机票可以向公司报销

健康与劳动保险

4. Tiket pesawat waktu pertama kali bergabung bisa diklaim ke perusahaan

jobs.title: Guest Relations Officer (GRO)
jobs.description: About the role Provide assistance to guests at Bandar Udara Internasional I Gusti Ngurah Rai lounge, including seating arrangements, flight information, and support for guests with special needs. Monitor the lounge regularly to ensure guest comfort and coordinate with operational teams to maintain service standards. Key responsibilities Provide assistance to guests, including helping with seating arrangements according to guest needs Collect feedback and Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) Monitor lounge area regularly to ensure guest comfort and needs are met Provide departure reminders to guests approaching flight times Assist guests in obtaining flight information, including schedule changes and departure gates Provide assistance to guests with special needs, including elderly guests, guests with disabilities, and families travelling with children Handle guest questions, requests, and complaints in a friendly, prompt, and professional manner Coordinate with operational teams to ensure lounge service runs smoothly Execute duties according to standard operating procedures and company service standards About you Minimum Diploma 1 (D1) education, preferably in Hotel Management, Tourism, Hospitality Management, or related field Experience in hospitality, hotel, lounge, airline, guest relations, customer service, or front office is an advantage Fresh graduates with hospitality internship experience are welcome to apply Active communication ability in English; proficiency in other foreign languages is an advantage Very good communication and interpersonal skills Neat and professional appearance according to company grooming standards Physical posture and condition that support service delivery and mobility in lounge area Friendly, confident, responsive, proactive, and strong service mindset Able to handle guest needs and complaints professionally Able to work individually and as part of a team Willing to work on shift system, including weekends and public holidays Willing to be placed at Bandar Udara Internasional I Gusti Ngurah Rai, Bali Able to join as soon as possible

About the role

Provide assistance to guests at Bandar Udara Internasional I Gusti Ngurah Rai lounge, including seating arrangements, flight information, and support for guests with special needs. Monitor the lounge regularly to ensure guest comfort and coordinate with operational teams to maintain service standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide assistance to guests, including helping with seating arrangements according to guest needs

  • Collect feedback and Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI)

  • Monitor lounge area regularly to ensure guest comfort and needs are met

  • Provide departure reminders to guests approaching flight times

  • Assist guests in obtaining flight information, including schedule changes and departure gates

  • Provide assistance to guests with special needs, including elderly guests, guests with disabilities, and families travelling with children

  • Fresh graduates with hospitality internship experience are welcome to apply

  • Active communication ability in English; proficiency in other foreign languages is an advantage

  • Very good communication and interpersonal skills

  • Neat and professional appearance according to company grooming standards

  • Physical posture and condition that support service delivery and mobility in lounge area

  • Friendly, confident, responsive, proactive, and strong service mindset

  • Able to handle guest needs and complaints professionally

  • Able to work individually and as part of a team

  • Willing to work on shift system, including weekends and public holidays

  • Willing to be placed at Bandar Udara Internasional I Gusti Ngurah Rai, Bali

  • Able to join as soon as possible

jobs.title: PROCUREMENT
jobs.description: PT. Delta Dewata' mencari profesional Procurement yang berpengalaman dan terorganisir untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Ubud, Bali. Sebagai Procurement Specialist, anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mengelola proses pembelian, negosiasi dengan vendor, dan memastikan ketersediaan material berkualitas tinggi yang mendukung operasional perusahaan. Posisi ini adalah jabatan fulltime yang memerlukan dedikasi penuh untuk mengoptimalkan efisiensi biaya sambil mempertahankan standar kualitas. Kandidat ideal memiliki kemampuan analitis yang kuat, keterampilan negosiasi yang excellent, dan pemahaman mendalam tentang supply chain management. Lokasi kerja berada di Ubud, Bali dengan lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan kolaboratif. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola seluruh proses procurement dari identifikasi kebutuhan, pencarian vendor, hingga penyelesaian transaksi pembelian. Melakukan riset pasar dan evaluasi vendor untuk memastikan kualitas material dan harga yang kompetitif sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan. Bernegosiasi dengan supplier untuk mencapai kondisi pembelian yang menguntungkan, termasuk harga, terms, dan delivery schedule. Memantau dan mengelola inventory untuk menghindari stockout atau overstock yang dapat mengganggu operasional. Membuat laporan pembelian, analisis biaya, dan rekomendasi untuk efisiensi procurement yang lebih baik. Menjalin hubungan yang baik dengan vendor dan mitra bisnis untuk memastikan kelancaran supply chain. Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap kebijakan pembelian perusahaan, prosedur internal, dan regulasi yang berlaku. Mengkoordinasikan dengan departemen lain untuk memahami kebutuhan material dan timeline pengiriman yang tepat. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal D3 atau Sarjana (S1) dalam bidang Manajemen, Logistik, Bisnis, atau Administrasi, atau pengalaman proksi di bidang terkait. Minimal 1 tahun pengalaman di bidang Procurement, Supply Chain, atau Purchasing di perusahaan manufaktur atau retail. Penguasaan yang kuat dalam Microsoft Office, khususnya Excel, dan pemahaman tentang sistem ERP atau procurement software. Kemampuan negosiasi dan komunikasi yang excellent, baik secara lisan maupun tertulis. Kemampuan berbahasa inggris. Kemampuan analisis data untuk mengidentifikasi tren biaya dan peluang penghematan. Keterampilan manajemen waktu dan kemampuan mengelola multiple tasks dengan baik dalam lingkungan yang dinamis. Pemahaman tentang supply chain management, logistik, dan best practices procurement. Integritas tinggi, akurat dalam detail, dan mampu bekerja dengan sistem yang terstruktur. Kemampuan beradaptasi dengan perubahan dan pemecahan masalah yang kreatif. Pengalaman dalam Brand Management atau industri terkait akan menjadi nilai tambah. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan standar industri serta pengalaman kerja. Tunjangan kesehatan yang komprehensif untuk karyawan dan keluarga. Cuti tahunan yang memadai dan fleksibel sesuai ketentuan hukum yang berlaku. Lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, kolaboratif, dan mendukung inovasi. Kesempatan untuk bekerja di salah satu destinasi wisata terindah Indonesia dengan kualitas hidup yang baik. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman procurement yang kuat dan passionate tentang supply chain management, kami mengundang Anda untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT. Delta Dewata'. Mohon kirimkan CV, portofolio pengalaman, dan surat motivasi Anda untuk mendapatkan kesempatan bergabung dengan organisasi kami yang terus berkembang. Lamar sekarang dan mulai perjalanan karir Anda bersama kami!

jobs.title: [Full Time] Finance & Accounting Staff
jobs.description: Timedoor is Bali-based IT company that provides services on website/mobile app/system development, online marketing, graphic design and AI System Integration. We're on the lookout for a passionate, driven, and creative staff to join our team as a Finance & Accounting Staff! Position - Full Time Job Responsibilities Record daily financial transactions and prepare monthly and annual financial reports, including the Profit & Loss Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement. Manage petty cash and daily cash flow, and process vendor invoice payments. Prepare and issue invoices to students' parents. Handle tax calculations and reporting, including Withholding Tax (PPh), Value Added Tax (PPN), and e-Faktur, while maintaining accurate and organized financial documentation. Qualifications Diploma (D3) or Bachelor's degree (S1) in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum of 1 year of experience in Finance and/or Accounting. Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including functions such as VLOOKUP and Pivot Tables, and experienced with accounting software (e.g., Accurate, Jurnal, SAP, or similar). Solid understanding of Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards (PSAK) and Indonesian taxation. Brevet Tax Certification is an advantage. Detail-oriented, trustworthy, highly accurate with numbers, and accountable. Willing to work on-site in Denpasar, Bali.
