jobs.title: AI Software & Data Engineer
jobs.description: About the role Altanova Teknologi Nusantara is looking for an AI Software & Data Engineer with strong software engineering skills and hands-on experience building AI, data, and software solutions. This is a practical, development-focused role spanning AI/ML, computer vision, generative AI and intelligent agents, backend development, data engineering, analytics, and deployment. You will work across the development lifecycle, from preparing data and developing AI models to building APIs and data pipelines, developing analytics solutions, integrating systems, and deploying applications in real-world environments. We do not expect candidates to be experts in every area listed below. We value strong fundamentals, hands-on development ability, technical curiosity, and the ability to independently learn and apply new technologies. Key responsibilities Design, develop, train, evaluate, optimize, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions. Develop computer vision applications involving image and video analysis, detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, or related techniques. Develop generative AI and LLM-based applications, including intelligent workflows and AI agents. Develop Python backend services and APIs supporting AI and data applications. Build and maintain data pipelines, databases, and datasets for AI, analytics, and reporting. Develop and support dashboards, reporting tools, and data visualization solutions. Integrate AI and software components with external applications, hardware, APIs, databases, and other systems. Deploy AI models and software applications across cloud, local, or edge-computing environments. Evaluate and optimize AI systems for accuracy, performance, reliability, computational efficiency, and cost. Monitor and troubleshoot deployed models, software, data pipelines, and system integrations. Research emerging AI technologies and evaluate their suitability for practical applications. Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering and product teams and maintain clear technical documentation. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. 3+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, AI/ML, data engineering, or applied technology development. Strong proficiency in Python and solid software engineering fundamentals. Strong understanding of machine learning and deep learning fundamentals. Hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications using modern machine learning or deep learning frameworks. Experience with backend development and APIs. Experience with SQL, databases, and data pipelines. Experience with Git/version control, debugging, and software testing. Familiarity with cloud or Linux-based development and deployment environments. Experience working with real-world datasets, including data preparation, validation, and model evaluation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate technical problems and develop practical solutions. Ability to read technical documentation and communicate effectively in English. Preferred Experience Experience in several of the following areas is preferred: Computer vision and deep learning Generative AI, LLM applications, multimodal AI, or AI agents Model fine-tuning, transfer learning, or optimization Python backend and API development Relational databases and data engineering Data visualization, dashboards, and business intelligence tools Cloud computing and application deployment Docker, Linux, and containerized applications AI model deployment and performance optimization Hardware or external system integration Real-time AI applications R&D, product development, startups, or rapid-prototyping environments What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who: Has real hands-on development experience, not simply familiarity with AI tools or APIs. Can work across AI, software, and data rather than focusing only on model development. Can build both AI components and the supporting software and data infrastructure needed to turn them into usable products. Understands how to objectively evaluate AI model performance. Is comfortable working with imperfect and real-world datasets. Can move efficiently from experimentation to working prototypes and deployed solutions. Builds software with reliability, maintainability, and performance in mind. Can independently learn new technologies and determine practical implementation approaches. Enjoys solving challenging technical problems and working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team. Is comfortable working onsite in Cikarang and participating in hands-on development, integration, and testing. Why Join Altanova Teknologi Nusantara At Altanova, you will work on practical technology-development projects at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computer vision, generative AI, data, software, cloud computing, and physical systems. Rather than focusing on only one layer of the technology stack, you will have opportunities to contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from AI experimentation and data engineering to backend development, analytics, system integration, testing, and deployment. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building complete systems, experimenting with emerging technologies, and turning AI concepts into practical working products.

About the role

Altanova Teknologi Nusantara is looking for an AI Software & Data Engineer with strong software engineering skills and hands-on experience building AI, data, and software solutions.

This is a practical, development-focused role spanning AI/ML, computer vision, generative AI and intelligent agents, backend development, data engineering, analytics, and deployment.

You will work across the development lifecycle, from preparing data and developing AI models to building APIs and data pipelines, developing analytics solutions, integrating systems, and deploying applications in real-world environments.

We do not expect candidates to be experts in every area listed below. We value strong fundamentals, hands-on development ability, technical curiosity, and the ability to independently learn and apply new technologies. 

Key responsibilities

  • Design, develop, train, evaluate, optimize, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions. 

  • Develop computer vision applications involving image and video analysis, detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, or related techniques. 

  • Develop generative AI and LLM-based applications, including intelligent workflows and AI agents. 

  • Develop Python backend services and APIs supporting AI and data applications. 

  • Build and maintain data pipelines, databases, and datasets for AI, analytics, and reporting. 

  • Develop and support dashboards, reporting tools, and data visualization solutions. 

  • Integrate AI and software components with external applications, hardware, APIs, databases, and other systems. 

  • Deploy AI models and software applications across cloud, local, or edge-computing environments. 

  • Evaluate and optimize AI systems for accuracy, performance, reliability, computational efficiency, and cost. 

  • Monitor and troubleshoot deployed models, software, data pipelines, and system integrations. 

  • Research emerging AI technologies and evaluate their suitability for practical applications. 

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering and product teams and maintain clear technical documentation. 

Required Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. 

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, AI/ML, data engineering, or applied technology development. 

  • Strong proficiency in Python and solid software engineering fundamentals. 

  • Strong understanding of machine learning and deep learning fundamentals. 

  • Hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications using modern machine learning or deep learning frameworks. 

  • Experience with backend development and APIs. 

  • Experience with SQL, databases, and data pipelines. 

  • Experience with Git/version control, debugging, and software testing. 

  • Familiarity with cloud or Linux-based development and deployment environments. 

  • Experience working with real-world datasets, including data preparation, validation, and model evaluation. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate technical problems and develop practical solutions. 

  • Ability to read technical documentation and communicate effectively in English. 

Preferred Experience 

Experience in several of the following areas is preferred:

  • Computer vision and deep learning 

  • Generative AI, LLM applications, multimodal AI, or AI agents 

  • Model fine-tuning, transfer learning, or optimization 

  • Python backend and API development 

  • Relational databases and data engineering 

  • Data visualization, dashboards, and business intelligence tools 

  • Cloud computing and application deployment 

  • Docker, Linux, and containerized applications 

  • AI model deployment and performance optimization 

  • Hardware or external system integration 

  • Real-time AI applications 

  • R&D, product development, startups, or rapid-prototyping environments 

What We Are Looking For 

We are looking for someone who: 

  • Has real hands-on development experience, not simply familiarity with AI tools or APIs. 

  • Can work across AI, software, and data rather than focusing only on model development. 

  • Can build both AI components and the supporting software and data infrastructure needed to turn them into usable products. 

  • Understands how to objectively evaluate AI model performance. 

  • Is comfortable working with imperfect and real-world datasets. 

  • Can move efficiently from experimentation to working prototypes and deployed solutions. 

  • Builds software with reliability, maintainability, and performance in mind. 

  • Can independently learn new technologies and determine practical implementation approaches. 

  • Enjoys solving challenging technical problems and working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team. 

  • Is comfortable working onsite in Cikarang and participating in hands-on development, integration, and testing. 

Why Join Altanova Teknologi Nusantara 

At Altanova, you will work on practical technology-development projects at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computer vision, generative AI, data, software, cloud computing, and physical systems. 

Rather than focusing on only one layer of the technology stack, you will have opportunities to contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from AI experimentation and data engineering to backend development, analytics, system integration, testing, and deployment. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building complete systems, experimenting with emerging technologies, and turning AI concepts into practical working products.

Pullman Ciawi Vimala Hills Resort Spa & Convention is a premium 5-star retreat sprawled across 14 hectares. The hotel is designed to immerse guests in breathtaking natural vistas and unrivaled tranquility. Pullman Ciawi Vimala Hills Resort Spa & Convention achieved the prestigious accolade of "Hotel of the Year" at the Accor Asia Leadership Conference. Job Description Job Description Infrastructure Management: Oversee the maintenance and stability of all IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, Wi-Fi systems, and property management systems (PMS/POS). Team Supervision: Supervise, schedule, and mentor IT support staff or technicians to ensure efficient 24/7 technical coverage. Hardware & Software Inventory: Manage hardware/software assets, licenses, and procurement of necessary IT equipment within budget. System Training: Train hotel staff on basic software applications, POS systems, and internal communication tools. Troubleshooting Skills: Advanced hardware and software problem-solving capabilities under high-pressure, mission-critical situations. Leadership: Proven ability to lead a technical team, manage vendor relationships, and handle project implementations. Languages: Fluent in English and Indonesian (oral and written). Attributes: Strong service-oriented mindset, proactive attitude, and flexibility to handle on-call emergencies when required.

Featuring 264 rooms with suites, accompanied by In Balance gym-spa & sauna, a Food Exchange restaurant, The Heritage restaurant, Parigie Coffee and Pastry, and Damsole Pool Bar offers wide National and International culinary selections for the social dining experience. The 700 sqm Grand Ballroom and 15 functional meeting rooms are available to cater to the meeting and social event needs. Large adaptable basement parking area of up to 450 cars Job Description Prepare comprehensive financial reports with detailed analysis, outlining trends, weaknesses and recommendations for corrective action. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management . Proficiency with hotel accounting systems, PMS, POS, and finance software , plus advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Solid understanding of tax regulations, statutory reporting, and compliance requirements . Knowledge of USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) is advantageous. Additional Information WHY WORK FOR ACCOR Employee benefit card offering discounted rates at Accor hotels worldwide. Develop your talent through Accor’s learning programs. Opportunity to grow within your property and across the world! Ability to contribute to the community and make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) activities.

jobs.title: SPA Manager
jobs.description: Company Description Join a hotel that is a member of the Accor network, whose group brings together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations. Here, we believe in you and what you bring to the table. There are many opportunities for development and advancement. Every gesture, every smile, every action, contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our customers, our colleagues and also for our planet. Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality. Take the opportunity to become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you in this world where life beats faster. Pullman Ciawi Vimala Hills Resort Spa & Convention is a premium 5-star retreat sprawled across 14 hectares. The hotel is designed to immerse guests in breathtaking natural vistas and unrivaled tranquility. Pullman Ciawi Vimala Hills Resort Spa & Convention achieved the prestigious accolade of "Hotel of the Year" at the Accor Asia Leadership Conference. As one of The Best Resort in Asia, the hotel offers 208 opulent rooms and 19 villas, 4 restaurants and bar, meeting rooms and convention centers, spa, entertainment and activities area. Job Description Job Description Daily Operations: Manage all spa, wellness, and fitness facility operations to ensure 5-star brand standards. Team Management: Recruit, mentor, schedule, and evaluate spa therapists, receptionists, and support staff. Revenue Management: Oversee budget planning, financial reporting, and the creation of promotional packages to drive sales. Quality Control: Ensure consistent service delivery, cleanliness, and maintenance of all spa and thermal equipment. Guest Relations: Proactively manage guest feedback and maintain high levels of guest satisfaction and personalization. Inventory Control: Manage procurement, stock levels, and cost-efficiency for all spa products and professional supplies. Compliance: Uphold strict health, safety, and hygiene standards in accordance with resort policy and government regulations. Qualifications Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Hospitality Management, Business, or professional Spa Therapy certification. Experience: 3–5 years of proven experience as a Spa Manager or Assistant Spa Manager in a luxury resort or hotel. Technical Proficiency: Expert knowledge of wellness trends and proficiency in Spa/Property Management Software (e.g., SpaSoft, Opera). Financial Acumen: Strong ability to manage P&L, budget forecasting, and inventory optimization. Leadership: Demonstrated capability to lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing team. Languages: Fluent in English (oral and written); knowledge of additional languages is an asset. Attributes: Exceptional grooming, professional demeanor, and ability to handle high-pressure environments. Network: Prior experience with international luxury hotel chains (Accor, Marriott, IHG, etc.) is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Bar Supervisor - Local Contract
jobs.description: Company Description A palace of refined luxury and privileged hospitality, Nusa Dua Beach Hotel and Spa is a five stars’ diamond hotel in Bali which has welcomed Kings and Queens, Presidents and Prime Ministers. Since its grand opening for the guests who expect the extraordinary to be imperative and unforgettable holidays experience awaits you at the luxurious Nusa Dua Beach Hotel and Spa. Now, Nusa Dua Beach Hotel & Spa joins Accor with the brand of Handwritten Collection. Located 25 minutes away from the Ngurah Rai International airport on the sun-drenched shores of beautiful Nusa Dua, the Nusa Dua Beach Hotel and Spa, 23 acres of the sculpted gardens provide an oasis of space and tranquility in the heart of exotic Bali. The accommodation features 381 rooms and suites in a resort hotel that invites you to immerse yourself in the pageantry of one of the world’s famous vibrant cultures. Job Description **Key Responsibilities:** As Bar Supervisor, you will oversee all aspects of bar operations while maintaining the exceptional service standards our resort guests expect. Your primary responsibilities include: Manage bar and beverage service across all resort outlets, including beach and pool areas, ensuring smooth operations and consistent quality standards throughout service hours. Coach and develop bar staff members, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages professional growth and maintains high performance standards. Deliver outstanding guest experiences by personally addressing inquiries and concerns with professionalism and genuine hospitality, turning every interaction into a memorable moment. Uphold all HACCP food safety protocols, allergen management procedures, and alcohol service regulations to protect our guests and maintain our resort's reputation. Oversee beverage selection, preparation standards, and inventory management to ensure every drink meets our resort's quality expectations. Address operational challenges and guest concerns with diplomacy and sound judgment, maintaining a positive atmosphere for both staff and guests. Track bar performance, manage costs, and implement improvements that enhance both operational efficiency and guest satisfaction. Qualifications Minimum 2 years of experience in the similar position in 5 stars hotels or resorts. Posses a great deal of positive attitude with commitment in guest experience & satisfaction. Good knowledge in HACCP (Food Safety), Alcohol Law and other safety regulations. High understanding about beverage quality, bar operations and beach/pool outlet management. Good interpersonal skill, , leadership, coaching and ability to resolve conflict. Additional Information Nusa Dua Beach Hotel & Spa always enforce work with passion and ethics with Balinese Hospitality Culture. We have the legacy of more than 40 years of hospitality since the hotel opens for public in 1983. Now, with Handwritten Collection, we are more in striving the guest experience in our resort.

Strong hands-on experience in: Java (Core Java, Servlets, JSP) or .NET (C#, VB.NET) Web services (REST/SOAP), APIs, and integrations Docker containerization Kubernetes (K8s) orchestration Terraform for Infrastructure as Code CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, etc.) Hands-on experience deploying applications on AWS/Azure/GCP or any cloud platforms. About the role

PT Altanova Teknologi Nusantara is looking for a Technical Project Manager (Engineering) with a strong engineering background and the ability to lead multidisciplinary technical projects from concept through implementation and deployment.

This is not a purely administrative project management role. We are looking for someone who can understand technical discussions, identify risks, coordinate engineering teams, work effectively with customers and suppliers, and independently drive projects forward.

The ideal candidate has a background in mechatronics, mechanical, electrical, automation, robotics, manufacturing, or a related engineering discipline, with experience coordinating or leading projects involving multiple technical areas.

You will serve as a key project owner connecting customers, engineering teams, suppliers, and management, with responsibility for keeping projects aligned with technical requirements, scope, schedule, cost, and performance objectives.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead engineering projects from requirements and concept development through design, procurement, fabrication, assembly, testing, installation, commissioning, and closeout.

  • Translate customer and business requirements into clear technical deliverables, acceptance criteria, milestones, and project plans.

  • Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams across mechanical, electrical, controls, software, automation, and manufacturing.

  • Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, priorities, resource requirements, and action items.

  • Track project progress, budgets, procurement, and major cost or schedule variances.

  • Identify technical, schedule, cost, resource, and supplier risks and drive appropriate mitigation actions.

  • Lead project meetings, design reviews, supplier discussions, and customer updates.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand technical issues and their impact on project scope, cost, schedule, and performance.

  • Coordinate with customers, suppliers, vendors, manufacturing partners, and internal teams.

  • Drive technical decisions, open issues, dependencies, and action items to closure.

  • Manage scope changes and clearly communicate their impact on requirements, cost, resources, and schedule.

  • Coordinate system integration, testing, installation, commissioning, field deployment, troubleshooting, and customer handover.

  • Maintain clear project documentation and provide timely status updates, risk assessments, and escalations to management.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electrical, Robotics, Automation, Industrial, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 3+ years of relevant engineering experience, with demonstrated experience coordinating or leading technical projects.

  • Experience with multidisciplinary engineering, automation, manufacturing, system integration, or product-development projects.

  • Strong understanding of the engineering development lifecycle, from requirements and concept development through design, fabrication, testing, and deployment.

  • Ability to read and understand technical drawings, specifications, requirements, and engineering documentation.

  • Strong project planning, organization, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.

  • Ability to identify technical and project risks and understand their impact on schedule, cost, and system performance.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, customers, suppliers, and management.

  • Ability to take ownership of projects and work independently with limited supervision.

  • Professional proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and good written and verbal English communication skills, particularly for technical discussions and documentation.

Preferred Experience

Experience in several of the following areas is preferred:

  • Mechatronics, robotics, or industrial automation

  • Machine design and system integration

  • Electrical and control systems

  • Product and prototype development

  • Manufacturing equipment and processes

  • System testing, installation, and commissioning

  • Field deployment and troubleshooting

  • Supplier and vendor management

  • Customer-facing engineering projects

  • Project budgeting and cost tracking

  • Experience with project management, scheduling, and collaboration tools. 

PMP or a similar certification is a plus, but technical judgment, ownership, problem-solving ability, and project leadership are more important.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of a technical project and independently:

  • Understand key requirements, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.

  • Determine the resources and engineering disciplines needed to execute the project.

  • Identify technical, schedule, cost, and supplier risks.

  • Recognize decisions, dependencies, and issues that are blocking progress.

  • Communicate and escalate important issues to customers and management.

  • Determine what needs to happen next and drive the team toward completion.

The right candidate is technically curious, organized, proactive, hands-on, and comfortable leading teams and taking ownership in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Why Join Altanova Teknologi Nusantara

At Altanova, you will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams on real-world technology, automation, and product-development projects.

You will have direct involvement throughout the project lifecycle, from early concepts and technical requirements through design, fabrication, testing, system integration, and deployment.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving technical problems, leading and coordinating people and resources, working with customers and suppliers, and taking ownership of projects from beginning to end.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend - Business Platform
jobs.description: Get to Know the Team We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Business Platform team in Jakarta, Indonesia. The Business Platform powers the backend capabilities that enable businesses and enterprises to onboard, operate, grow, and serve consumers at scale across Southeast Asia. Get to Know the Role In this role, you will design, build, and evolve backend platform services that manage business profiles, store metadata, business configuration, and related operational workflows. You'll work on systems that sit close to the source of truth for business data and workflows—systems that directly influence how businesses set up their operations, how internal teams operate reliably, and how downstream products consume trusted business information. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong ownership, pragmatic system design thinking, and a commitment to building platforms that simplify complexity rather than spread it around. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Design, build, and maintain low-latency RESTful/GraphQL APIs and distributed microservices capable of handling heavy traffic loads. Schema design, data modeling, and query optimization across relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/caching databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis). Set up automated monitoring, logging, and tracing to proactively diagnose bottlenecks, maintain security best practices, and resolve production outages. Manage automated CI/CD pipelines, containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure) for smooth, reliable releases. Author comprehensive unit/integration tests, participate in code reviews, and write clear technical design documentation to manage technical debt.

jobs.title: Solution Specialist, Finance Systems
jobs.description: Get to Know the Team Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) aims to be a technology leader that provides predictive and seamless experiences to all Grab employees (Grabbers). We are a diverse team of technology practitioners looking to outserve Grabbers with positive, personalised IT experiences, and we are looking for individuals with similar customer-centric and values to join our growing team. Get to Know the Role The Senior Solution Specialist will report directly to the Delivery Manager for Finance Systems. As a Solution Specialist, Finance Systems , you will work with GTS teams and Finance users to understand challenges, current processes and system requirements. You will translate these needs into future-state application requirements, process improvements and solution designs, working with other teams and external implementation partners where required. You will focus on managing change requests and project implementations within the Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP environment, with an emphasis on Record-to-Report (R2R) processes. Experience in Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) will be an advantage. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Lead Finance Systems change requests and project implementations from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, deployment and post-go-live stabilisation. Collaborate with Finance partners to understand needs, document all-state processes, standardise requirements and perform fit-gap analysis. Translate requirements into functional solution designs, configuration recommendations, process improvements and implementation plans. Assess the impact, risks, dependencies and priorities of proposed changes across finance processes, data, integrations and related applications. Coordinate System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect resolution, test-result validation and business approval. Work with technical teams, Oracle Support, implementation partners and Finance partners to deliver integrations, data migrations, enhancements, releases and quarterly Oracle Fusion Cloud upgrades. Evaluate new Oracle platform capabilities and conduct Proofs of Concept (POCs) to assess feasibility, value and agreement on Finance requirements. Drive change adoption through process documentation, user guides, training materials, partner communication, knowledge transfer and continuous improvement of R2R processes.

jobs.title: Strategy & Planning Food, Associate
jobs.description: Get to Know the Team Join the Strategy and Planning team at Grab — the team responsible for driving holistic business health across the GrabFood platform. We don't just own demand; we cover the full picture: supply reliability, merchant performance, and competitive intelligence across the markets we operate in. Working alongside Commercial, Operations, and Central Strategy, we are the analytical backbone that keeps the GrabFood business sharp — tracking performance, diagnosing gaps, benchmarking against competition, and translating insights into decisions that move the business. If you want to understand how a food delivery platform truly works end to end, this is the team. Get to Know the Role You will report to the GrabFood S&P Region Lead and co-own the GrabFood business for your managed region alongside Region Operations and Commercial teams. You will work closely with the Central S&P team to translate strategic direction into on-the-ground execution — and equally, to surface the insights and risks from your region back to leadership before they become problems. This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. You will be expected to travel to your managed region regularly for stakeholder collaboration and market visits. You will be based fully onsite from Jakarta's office. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Monitor and evaluate business & financial performance across key metrics, identify deviations and providing data-driven recommendations to address them Drive demand-side analysis to support growth strategies, covering promotional effectiveness, campaign design, and user analysis Track and diagnose supply-side health, collaborating with operations and marketplace team to surface friction points and support marketplace efficiency Maintain competitive and market intelligence to identify opportunities and inform strategic positioning within the Online Food Delivery landscape Translate strategic direction into region-level action plans, aligning with cross-functional teams to drive execution Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders, synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights

{"@context": "https://schema.org/", "@type": "JobPosting", "title": "Account Officer Mikro (AOM) Malang Raya", "description": "

Deskripsi Pekerjaan :

  • Melakukan prospek, memperkenalkan dan memasarkan produk ULaMM kepada calon nasabah/masyarakat

  • Melakukan seleksi awal, kunjungan ke lokasi nasabah, jaminan dan lokasi tempat tinggal/domisili, serta melakukan analisa permohonan pembiayaan

  • Memproses dan mengusulkan permintaan pinjaman kepada atasan

  • Monitoring, mengelola dan melakukan pemeliharaan (maintenance) ke nasabah paska pencairan, perkembangan usaha serta melakukan pembinaan dalam rangka pengembangan kapasitas usaha nasabah

  • Melakukan maintenance nabasah untuk memastikan kelancaran angsuran

  • Pendidikan minimal D3 semua jurusan (diutamakan S1)

  • Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 1 tahun sebagai Sales/Marketing (di utamakan berpengalaman di lembaga pembiayaan keuangan mikro, seperti BPR, Koperasi, dan Multifinance)

  • Menguasai program Microsoft Office

  • Memiliki jaringan luas, customer base, kemampuan analisa, target oriented dan maintenance pembiyaan

  • Responsif dan memiliki orientasi pada layanan pelanggan (customer focus)

  • Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik serta memahami bahasa dan budaya lokal di area kerja

  • Memiliki SIM-C aktif

  • Bersedia ditempatkan di Malang Raya (Kota/Kabupaten Malang dan Batu)

  • Reward Religi & Non-Religi

jobs.title: Maintenance Supervisor
jobs.description: Berpengalaman sebagai Maintenance Supervisor di Industri Manufaktur? Tertantang untuk bisa bekerja dengan target dan memimpin tim dengan efektif? Anda berkesempatan untuk bergabung dengan kami sebagai Maintenance Supervisor PT Superior Prima Sukses Tbk! Dalam peran ini Anda akan berkesempatan memimpin anak buah untuk tim maintenance (mekanik & elektrikal) dan bertanggung jawab terhadap troubleshooting dan improvement terkait maintenance. Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Memastikan pelaksanaan Patrol Maintenance berjalan secara berkala, sehingga dapat mendeteksi permasalahan pada mesin dan dilakukan perbaikan. Melaksanakan dan memonitor proses pemeliharaan mesin, sehingga dapat dilakukan sesuai dengan prosedur yang berlaku. Memonitor penyelesaian MWR pada area yang menjadi tanggung jawabnya. Mengidentifikasi dan memetakan resiko kerusakan pada mesin sehingga dapat dilakukan pencegahan. Kualifikasi: D3/D4/S1 Teknik Mesin/Mekatronika Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Mechanical Supervisor/Coordinator, diutamakan dari industri manufaktur Pengalaman dalam memimpin dan mengarahkan tim Mampu membaca gambar teknik dan menguasai alat kerja teknik Memahami mesin pneumatik dan hidrolis, sistem perpipaan dan tangki, serta dasar elektrik Menguasai metode predictive maintenance berbasis data Menguasai Planned Maintenance menjadi nilai tambah Memiliki jiwa leadership yang baik Menyukai pekerjaan lapangan dan data Tidak alergi debu Penempatan di Lamongan (Jawa Timur) Benefit: Mess, Makan 3x, BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan

About the role

Grand Delight is seeking an enthusiastic and ambitious Sales Intern to join our dynamic sales team on a part-time basis in our Seminyak, Bali location. Key responsibilities

  • Assist in identifying and reaching out to potential customers through various sales channels

  • Flexible part-time working arrangements that complement your personal or academic commitments

  • Competitive remuneration package including performance-based incentives

  • Access to comprehensive product training and sales resources

  • Opportunity to expand your professional network in Bali's thriving business community

jobs.title: Accounting Supervisor
jobs.description: Kualifikasi Supervisor Accounting Persyaratan Umum: Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, atau bidang terkait. Usia maksimal 37 tahun. Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 3–5 tahun di bidang akuntansi, dengan setidaknya 1–2 tahun di posisi supervisor atau posisi manajerial setara. Memiliki sertifikasi Brevet A & B menjadi nilai tambah. Kemampuan Teknis: Menguasai prinsip-prinsip akuntansi dan perpajakan yang berlaku umum (PSAK & PPh). Mampu menyusun laporan keuangan bulanan dan tahunan secara akurat dan tepat waktu. Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat tentang proses audit internal & eksternal. Mampu melakukan rekonsiliasi bank, kontrol terhadap jurnal transaksi, serta analisis laporan keuangan. Menguasai software akuntansi seperti Accurate, SAP, atau sejenisnya. Terampil menggunakan Microsoft Excel (pivot table, vlookup, dll). Kemampuan Manajerial & Pribadi: Memiliki jiwa kepemimpinan dan mampu membina serta mengawasi tim. Mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan dengan tenggat waktu yang ketat. Teliti, jujur, dan bertanggung jawab. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan interpersonal yang baik. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.

About the role

We are seeking a talented Digital Marketing & Social Media Specialist to join the Grand Delight team in Bali. This is a full-time position that offers a unique opportunity to work in a vibrant, tropical setting whilst developing your expertise in digital marketing and social media strategy. You will play a crucial role in building and maintaining our brand presence across digital platforms, driving engagement, and supporting the company's growth objectives through targeted digital campaigns and compelling social media content.

What you'll be doing

  • Developing and implementing comprehensive social media strategies across multiple platforms including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and LinkedIn

  • Creating, curating and publishing engaging content that resonates with our target audience and aligns with brand guidelines

  • Managing and monitoring social media accounts, responding to comments, messages and enquiries in a timely manner

  • Analysing social media performance metrics and providing regular reports on engagement, reach and campaign effectiveness

  • Conducting market research and competitor analysis to identify trends and opportunities for digital marketing initiatives

  • Planning and executing paid digital advertising campaigns across social media platforms and search engines

  • Collaborating with the broader marketing team to ensure consistency in messaging and brand positioning

  • Staying up-to-date with industry trends, algorithm changes and best practices in digital marketing

  • Supporting the development of influencer partnerships and brand collaborations


What we're looking for

  • Proven experience of 2-4 years working in digital marketing or social media management roles

  • Expertise in managing social media platforms and creating engaging content that drives engagement and brand awareness

  • Strong understanding of social media analytics tools, Google Analytics and performance tracking

  • Knowledge of paid social media advertising and experience managing digital advertising budgets

  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to craft compelling copy for various digital channels

  • Proficiency in graphic design tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar software

  • Experience with SEO and SEM (Search Engine Marketing) principles and best practices

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously

  • Creative mindset with the ability to develop innovative ideas and execute them effectively

  • Familiarity with content management systems and social media scheduling tools

  • A passion for staying current with digital marketing trends and emerging technologies

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams

  • Preferred: Experience in hospitality, tourism or lifestyle sectors


What we offer

  • Full-time employment with a dynamic and creative team in a beautiful Bali location

  • Competitive salary package commensurate with experience

  • Opportunity to work in the heart of Bali's thriving business community

  • Professional development opportunities to expand your digital marketing skills and certifications

  • Collaborative work environment that values innovation and creative thinking

  • Health and wellness benefits including health insurance coverage

  • Flexible work arrangements where appropriate

  • Access to industry training and digital marketing tools

  • Career progression opportunities within the Grand Delight family


About us

Grand Delight is a forward-thinking company dedicated to creating exceptional experiences and delivering quality solutions to our customers. We are committed to innovation, creativity and excellence in everything we do. Our team thrives on collaboration, fresh ideas and a passion for digital excellence. Based in the stunning location of Bali, we offer a unique workplace culture that combines professional ambition with a relaxed, tropical lifestyle. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an environment where talent can flourish and make a real impact on our business success.

Ready to make an impact?

If you are a passionate digital marketer with a flair for social media and a desire to work in a vibrant location, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to join the Grand Delight team and help us grow our digital presence to new heights.

jobs.description: About the role We are seeking a Finance Admin to join the team at Grand Delight in Seminyak, Bali. This is a full-time position that plays a crucial role in supporting the financial operations and administrative functions of our organisation. As Finance Admin, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, processing transactions, and ensuring that all accounting and financial reporting activities run smoothly. This role is essential to the accuracy and efficiency of our financial management processes. What you'll be doing Processing and recording financial transactions, including invoices, expenses, and payments Maintaining and reconciling general ledger accounts and bank statements Preparing financial documents and supporting schedules for management review Assisting in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports Managing accounts payable and accounts receivable functions Filing and organising financial records in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements Supporting the finance team with general administrative tasks and data entry Assisting with budget tracking and variance analysis Liaising with vendors, clients, and internal departments regarding financial matters Ensuring compliance with financial procedures and internal controls What we're looking for Proven experience in a finance or accounting administrative role, preferably in a similar industry or corporate environment Strong proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel Solid understanding of accounting principles, general ledger operations, and financial reporting processes Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial record-keeping Professional communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues Relevant qualifications in accounting, finance, or business administration are advantageous Experience with financial reconciliation and bank statement matching Familiarity with accounts payable and receivable processes Knowledge of financial compliance and regulatory requirements What we offer At Grand Delight, we are committed to creating a supportive and rewarding work environment for our employees. We offer competitive remuneration packages, opportunities for professional development, and a collaborative workplace culture that values our team members. We provide a full-time position with structured working hours, allowing for a healthy work-life balance. Our team is dedicated to supporting employee growth and providing clear pathways for career advancement within the finance and accounting sector. We believe in investing in our employees' development and wellbeing. About us Grand Delight is a dynamic and growing organisation based in Seminyak, Bali. We are committed to delivering excellence in our operations and maintaining the highest standards of financial integrity and transparency. Our team is composed of dedicated professionals who are passionate about their work and committed to supporting the company's mission. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative and inclusive workplace where innovation and continuous improvement are encouraged. At Grand Delight, we value professionalism, accuracy, and a commitment to achieving our organisational objectives. Apply now If you are a detail-oriented finance professional with strong administrative skills and a commitment to financial accuracy, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter, and any relevant qualifications to apply for this Finance Admin position at Grand Delight.

About the role

We are seeking a Finance Admin to join the team at Grand Delight in Seminyak, Bali. This is a full-time position that plays a crucial role in supporting the financial operations and administrative functions of our organisation. As Finance Admin, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, processing transactions, and ensuring that all accounting and financial reporting activities run smoothly. This role is essential to the accuracy and efficiency of our financial management processes.

What you'll be doing

  1. Processing and recording financial transactions, including invoices, expenses, and payments

  2. Maintaining and reconciling general ledger accounts and bank statements

  3. Preparing financial documents and supporting schedules for management review

  4. Assisting in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports

  5. Managing accounts payable and accounts receivable functions

  6. Filing and organising financial records in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements

  7. Supporting the finance team with general administrative tasks and data entry

  8. Assisting with budget tracking and variance analysis

  9. Liaising with vendors, clients, and internal departments regarding financial matters

  10. Ensuring compliance with financial procedures and internal controls


What we're looking for

  1. Proven experience in a finance or accounting administrative role, preferably in a similar industry or corporate environment

  2. Strong proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel

  3. Solid understanding of accounting principles, general ledger operations, and financial reporting processes

  4. Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines

  6. Professional communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues

  8. Experience with financial reconciliation and bank statement matching

  9. Familiarity with accounts payable and receivable processes

We offer competitive remuneration packages, opportunities for professional development, and a collaborative workplace culture that values our team members. We provide a full-time position with structured working hours, allowing for a healthy work-life balance. Our team is dedicated to supporting employee growth and providing clear pathways for career advancement within the finance and accounting sector. We believe in investing in our employees' development and wellbeing.

About us

Grand Delight is a dynamic and growing organisation based in Seminyak, Bali. We are committed to delivering excellence in our operations and maintaining the highest standards of financial integrity and transparency. Our team is composed of dedicated professionals who are passionate about their work and committed to supporting the company's mission. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative and inclusive workplace where innovation and continuous improvement are encouraged. At Grand Delight, we value professionalism, accuracy, and a commitment to achieving our organisational objectives.

Apply now

If you are a detail-oriented finance professional with strong administrative skills and a commitment to financial accuracy, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter, and any relevant qualifications to apply for this Finance Admin position at Grand Delight.

jobs.title: Remedial Officer - Bandar Lampung (Lampung)
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan : Menerima daftar kunjungan harian remedial (DKHR) dan melaksanakannya sesuai dengan area yang ditugaskan. Melaksanakan penagihan/penerimaan unit kendaran atas nasabah yang memiliki keterlambatan pembayaran (overdue1-60 hari). jobs.title: Staff Admin Tax
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami mencari seorang Staff Admin Tax yang terampil dan detail-oriented untuk bergabung dengan tim Akuntansi dan Perpajakan di Tri Express'. Sebagai Staff Admin Tax, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mengelola berbagai aspek administrasi pajak dan memastikan kepatuhan perusahaan terhadap regulasi perpajakan yang berlaku. Posisi ini memerlukan pemahaman mendalam tentang peraturan perpajakan Indonesia dan kemampuan untuk menangani dokumentasi pajak dengan akurat. Ini adalah posisi fulltime yang berlokasi di Deli Serdang, Sumatera Utara, dengan fokus pada operasional harian yang efisien dan tepat waktu. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Min Tamatan SMA, Diploma atau Sarjana (S1) dalam bidang Akuntansi, Pajak, atau disiplin ilmu terkait lainnya. Memiliki minimal 1 tahun pengalaman dalam administrasi pajak atau posisi sejenis di bidang akuntansi. Pemahaman yang kuat tentang peraturan perpajakan Indonesia, termasuk SPT, PPh, dan PPN. Menguasai penggunaan software akuntansi dan spreadsheet (Microsoft Excel), serta berpengalaman dengan sistem E-Faktur dan aplikasi coretax. Kemampuan analitis yang baik dengan perhatian tinggi terhadap detail dan akurasi data. Bersifat terorganisir, dapat mengelola banyak tugas secara bersamaan, dan mampu bekerja dalam tim. Pengalaman dengan sistem perpajakan online dan pelaporan digital adalah nilai tambah. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memenuhi kualifikasi di atas dan bersemangat untuk berkontribusi dalam administrasi pajak yang efisien dan akurat, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar posisi ini. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan portofolio pekerjaan Anda kepada tim Human Resources kami.

jobs.title: Programmer CNC (Alphacam/NX  5 Axis) Furniture
jobs.description: Job Deskripsi : Programmer CNC menggunakan CAM Alphacam / NX 5 Asis. Membuat, memodifikasi, dan mengoptimalkan program CNC (G-Code & M-Code) untuk mesin CNC Menganalisis gambar teknik dan menentukan urutan pemesinan yang paling efisien. Melakukan setting mesin CNC secara mandiri. Menguji coba program dan melakukan penyesuaian untuk memastikan kualitas dan toleransi produk sesuai spesifikasi. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan SMK, Gelar Diploma atau Sarjana Teknik Mesin / Vokasi Industri. Mampu membuat program untuk mesin CNC dengan software CAM Alphacam / NX 5 Axis. Mampu mengoperasikan mesin CNC. Mampu membaca dan memahami gambar teknik dengan baik. Memahami G-Code dan M-Code. Berpengalaman dengan kontroler CNC Pengalaman Minimal 3 tahun sebagai Programmer di industri manufaktur / Furniture. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik lisan maupun tertulis. Teliti, cermat, dan mampu menangani beberapa tugas secara efektif. Berpengalaman diperusahaan Furnitur lebih disukai

jobs.title: Sales Canvassing Sparepart Mobil
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT. YOKOMITSU AUTO PARTS mencari Sales Canvassing Sparepart Mobil yang berdedikasi dan bersemangat untuk bergabung dengan tim penjualan kami di Surabaya dan sekitarnya. Posisi ini bertanggung jawab untuk menyebarkan luaskan pelanggan yang termasuk Toko-toko/Bengkel di Wilayah Surabaya dan sekitarnya, meningkatkan penjualan, juga memperluas pasar sparepart aftermarket mobil di wilayah Surabaya dan sekitarnya. Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman di bidang Sales, khususnya industri sparepart mobil, memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, serta terbiasa bekerja dengan target, kami mengajak anda untuk bergabung bersama kami di PT Yokomitsu Auto Parts. Sebagai Sales Canvassing, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mengidentifikasi dan mengembangkan peluang penjualan baru dengan melakukan kunjungan langsung ke bengkel, showroom, dan klien potensial lainnya. Posisi ini menawarkan kesempatan untuk membangun hubungan bisnis yang kuat sambil mempromosikan produk suku cadang mobil berkualitas tinggi kami. Tanggung Jawab Utama Melakukan kunjungan lapangan (canvassing) ke bengkel, dealer, dan klien potensial untuk mempromosikan produk suku cadang mobil kami. Mengidentifikasi dan mengembangkan peluang penjualan baru melalui prospecting yang efektif dan strategi outreach yang terukur. Memberikan presentasi produk yang menarik dan informatif kepada calon pelanggan, menjelaskan fitur, manfaat, dan harga produk kami. Membangun dan mempertahankan hubungan jangka panjang dengan pelanggan untuk mendorong pembelian berulang dan loyalitas merek. Mencapai target penjualan yang telah ditetapkan dan melaporkan progress penjualan secara berkala kepada manajemen. Mengumpulkan feedback pelanggan dan informasi pasar untuk membantu peningkatan produk dan strategi penjualan. Mengelola pipeline penjualan dengan akurat dan memperbarui sistem CRM secara konsisten. Menangani pertanyaan pelanggan dan menyelesaikan masalah dengan profesional dan responsif. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman dalam bidang penjualan, khususnya di industri otomotif atau sparepart mobil. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau setara; gelar diploma/sarjana dalam bidang terkait sangat dihargai. Memiliki pengetahuan yang baik tentang produk otomotif dan suku cadang mobil. Kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik, persuasif, dan mampu membangun rapport dengan berbagai tipe pelanggan. Keterampilan negosiasi yang kuat dan kemampuan menutup penjualan secara efektif. Memiliki motivasi tinggi, proaktif, dan berorientasi pada hasil dan pencapaian target. Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dan dapat bekerja secara independen maupun dalam tim. Memiliki kendaraan pribadi dan Surat Izin Mengemudi (SIM) yang valid untuk mobilitas di lapangan. Kemauan untuk melakukan perjalanan rutin ke berbagai lokasi di Surabaya Integritas tinggi, profesional, dan dapat dipercaya dalam menjalin hubungan bisnis. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji pokok yang kompetitif dengan sistem komisi berbasis performa yang menguntungkan. Tunjangan transportasi dan uang makan untuk mendukung aktivitas lapangan. Program bonus insentif bulanan dan tahunan berdasarkan pencapaian target penjualan. Kesempatan pengembangan karier yang jelas dengan peluang promosi ke posisi manajemen. Program pelatihan dan pengembangan keterampilan penjualan secara berkelanjutan. Paket asuransi kesehatan untuk karyawan dan keluarga. Lingkungan kerja yang supportif dan tim yang kolaboratif. Pengakuan dan apresiasi atas pencapaian performa yang luar biasa. Tentang PT. YOKOMITSU AUTO PARTS PT. YOKOMITSU AUTO PARTS adalah perusahaan terkemuka dalam industri suku cadang otomotif di Indonesia yang berkomitmen untuk menyediakan produk berkualitas tinggi dengan harga kompetitif kepada bengkel, dealer, dan konsumen akhir. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri, kami memiliki reputasi solid sebagai mitra terpercaya dalam menyuplai suku cadang mobil yang autentik dan bergaransi. Perusahaan kami mengedepankan inovasi, kualitas, dan kepuasan pelanggan sebagai fondasi bisnis. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan kami dibangun oleh tim yang berbakat, dedikasi, dan passionate dalam melayani pelanggan. PT. YOKOMITSU AUTO PARTS menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, dinamis, dan memberikan peluang karier yang nyata bagi setiap karyawan untuk tumbuh dan berkembang. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman penjualan yang solid dan antusias untuk bergabung dengan tim kami, kami dengan senang hati menerima aplikasi Anda. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan referensi Anda ke tim Human Resources kami. Bergabunglah dengan PT. YOKOMITSU AUTO PARTS dan mulai karir penjualan yang sukses bersama kami di Surabaya, Jawa Timur area!

jobs.title: Admin Project (Finance Support)
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami mencari Admin Project (Finance Support) yang detail-oriented dan terorganisir untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT Mandiri Pallazo Kreasindo. Sebagai Admin Project, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mendukung kelancaran operasional proyek-proyek desain dan arsitektur kami melalui manajemen aspek finansial dan administratif. Posisi ini memerlukan kemampuan yang kuat dalam koordinasi, pencatatan data, dan komunikasi lintas departemen untuk memastikan setiap proyek berjalan dengan efisien dari segi finansial dan administrasi. About the role

Menjalankan live streaming sehari-hari di ruang siaran brand, menyampaikan keunggulan produk pakaian dalam dan nilai brand sekaligus mendemonstrasikan efek pemakaian, mengarahkan penonton untuk menyelesaikan pemesanan.

Key responsibilities

  • Menjalankan live streaming sehari-hari di ruang siaran brand, menyampaikan keunggulan produk pakaian dalam dan nilai brand sekaligus mendemonstrasikan efek pemakaian, mengarahkan penonton untuk menyelesaikan pemesanan

  • Berinteraksi aktif dengan penggemar selama siaran, menjawab seluruh pertanyaan penonton, menjaga suasana positif di ruang live, meningkatkan aktivitas pengikut, dan menambah jumlah penggemar baru secara efektif

  • Bekerja sama dengan tim operasional untuk penyusunan skrip siaran dan pengambilan konten video pendek, serta mengoptimalkan ritme dan efek interaksi live streaming

  • Mematuhi peraturan platform live streaming dan standar konten brand secara ketat, menjaga citra profesional dan sopan selama siaran, serta menyajikan konten panduan gaya yang positif dan sehat

About you

  • Memiliki penampilan dan aura yang baik, ekspresi alami di depan kamera, serta tampil menarik di layar

  • Bahasa Indonesia setara penutur asli / lancar, berbicara jelas dan runtut, memiliki daya tarik verbal yang kuat serta kemampuan mengendalikan suasana siaran

  • Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman live streaming kategori pakaian dalam atau fashion umum, memahami peraturan platform live streaming utama seperti TikTok, Shopee Live, dan Lazada Live

  • Memiliki pengetahuan dasar tentang produk pakaian dalam, memahami logika kecocokan bahan, potongan, dan bentuk tubuh, mampu menjelaskan keunggulan produk dengan jelas serta memberikan rekomendasi jawaban kepada pelanggan

  • Bersedia mengikuti jadwal shift live streaming (termasuk shift malam), serta berpartisipasi dalam peningkatan dan perbaikan mekanisme siaran

jobs.title: Sales Canvassing Sparepart Mobil
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT. YOKOMITSU AUTO PARTS mencari Sales Canvassing Sparepart Mobil yang berdedikasi dan bersemangat untuk bergabung dengan tim penjualan kami di Bandung dan sekitarnya. Posisi ini bertanggung jawab untuk menyebarkan luaskan pelanggan yang termasuk Toko-toko/Bengkel di Wilayah Bandung dan sekitarnya, meningkatkan penjualan, juga memperluas pasar sparepart aftermarket mobil di wilayah Bandung dan sekitarnya. Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman di bidang Sales, khususnya industri sparepart mobil, memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, serta terbiasa bekerja dengan target, kami mengajak anda untuk bergabung bersama kami di PT Yokomitsu Auto Parts. Sebagai Sales Canvassing, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mengidentifikasi dan mengembangkan peluang penjualan baru dengan melakukan kunjungan langsung ke bengkel, showroom, dan klien potensial lainnya. Posisi ini menawarkan kesempatan untuk membangun hubungan bisnis yang kuat sambil mempromosikan produk suku cadang mobil berkualitas tinggi kami. Tanggung Jawab Utama Melakukan kunjungan lapangan (canvassing) ke bengkel, dealer, dan klien potensial untuk mempromosikan produk suku cadang mobil kami. Mengidentifikasi dan mengembangkan peluang penjualan baru melalui prospecting yang efektif dan strategi outreach yang terukur. Memberikan presentasi produk yang menarik dan informatif kepada calon pelanggan, menjelaskan fitur, manfaat, dan harga produk kami. Membangun dan mempertahankan hubungan jangka panjang dengan pelanggan untuk mendorong pembelian berulang dan loyalitas merek. Mencapai target penjualan yang telah ditetapkan dan melaporkan progress penjualan secara berkala kepada manajemen. Mengumpulkan feedback pelanggan dan informasi pasar untuk membantu peningkatan produk dan strategi penjualan. Mengelola pipeline penjualan dengan akurat dan memperbarui sistem CRM secara konsisten. Menangani pertanyaan pelanggan dan menyelesaikan masalah dengan profesional dan responsif. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman dalam bidang penjualan, khususnya di industri otomotif atau sparepart mobil. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau setara; gelar diploma/sarjana dalam bidang terkait sangat dihargai. Memiliki pengetahuan yang baik tentang produk otomotif dan suku cadang mobil. Kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik, persuasif, dan mampu membangun rapport dengan berbagai tipe pelanggan. Keterampilan negosiasi yang kuat dan kemampuan menutup penjualan secara efektif. Memiliki motivasi tinggi, proaktif, dan berorientasi pada hasil dan pencapaian target. Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dan dapat bekerja secara independen maupun dalam tim. Memiliki kendaraan pribadi dan Surat Izin Mengemudi (SIM) yang valid untuk mobilitas di lapangan. Kemauan untuk melakukan perjalanan rutin ke berbagai lokasi di Jawa Barat. Integritas tinggi, profesional, dan dapat dipercaya dalam menjalin hubungan bisnis. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji pokok yang kompetitif dengan sistem komisi berbasis performa yang menguntungkan. Tunjangan transportasi dan uang makan untuk mendukung aktivitas lapangan. Program bonus insentif bulanan dan tahunan berdasarkan pencapaian target penjualan. Kesempatan pengembangan karier yang jelas dengan peluang promosi ke posisi manajemen. Program pelatihan dan pengembangan keterampilan penjualan secara berkelanjutan. Paket asuransi kesehatan untuk karyawan dan keluarga. Lingkungan kerja yang supportif dan tim yang kolaboratif. Pengakuan dan apresiasi atas pencapaian performa yang luar biasa. Tentang PT. YOKOMITSU AUTO PARTS PT. YOKOMITSU AUTO PARTS adalah perusahaan terkemuka dalam industri suku cadang otomotif di Indonesia yang berkomitmen untuk menyediakan produk berkualitas tinggi dengan harga kompetitif kepada bengkel, dealer, dan konsumen akhir. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri, kami memiliki reputasi solid sebagai mitra terpercaya dalam menyuplai suku cadang mobil yang autentik dan bergaransi. Perusahaan kami mengedepankan inovasi, kualitas, dan kepuasan pelanggan sebagai fondasi bisnis. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan kami dibangun oleh tim yang berbakat, dedikasi, dan passionate dalam melayani pelanggan. PT. YOKOMITSU AUTO PARTS menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, dinamis, dan memberikan peluang karier yang nyata bagi setiap karyawan untuk tumbuh dan berkembang. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman penjualan yang solid dan antusias untuk bergabung dengan tim kami, kami dengan senang hati menerima aplikasi Anda. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan referensi Anda ke tim Human Resources kami. Bergabunglah dengan PT. YOKOMITSU AUTO PARTS dan mulai karir penjualan yang sukses bersama kami di Bandung area!

jobs.title: Captain Waiter
jobs.description: About the role Wet Plate Kitchen is seeking an experienced Captain Waiter to join our hospitality team in Bali. This is a contract position that offers an excellent opportunity to lead and manage dining service operations in a dynamic, customer-focused environment. As Captain Waiter, you will be at the forefront of guest experience, overseeing table service, coordinating with kitchen and bar staff, and ensuring exceptional standards are maintained throughout every service. Key responsibilities Lead and supervise dining service operations, ensuring all guests receive attentive, professional and courteous service Manage table assignments, seating arrangements and service flow to optimise guest satisfaction and operational efficiency Train, mentor and guide junior waitstaff and supporting service personnel on service standards and procedures Take food and beverage orders accurately, with knowledge of menu items, specials and pairing recommendations Liaise effectively between guests, kitchen staff and management to address any service issues or special requests promptly Monitor table service during all meal periods, ensuring plates are cleared appropriately and glasses remain filled Maintain exceptional standards of cleanliness, presentation and etiquette in the dining area Handle guest complaints with professionalism and discretion, seeking resolution in line with company policy Assist with pre-service and post-service duties, including table setup, stock management and closing procedures Maintain knowledge of current promotions, menu changes and beverage selections to enhance guest recommendations What we're looking for Can join immediately Minimum 3-5 years' experience as a waiter or captain waiter in a hotel, restaurant or upscale dining establishment Proven ability to lead and motivate junior staff members in a fast-paced service environment Excellent knowledge of food and beverage service standards, protocols and etiquette Strong communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with guests from diverse backgrounds Outstanding customer service orientation with a genuine commitment to exceeding guest expectations Ability to remain calm, organised and composed during peak service periods Proficiency in point-of-sale (POS) systems and reservation management software Fluency in English required; additional languages such as Indonesian or Mandarin are advantageous Physical ability to stand for extended periods and carry items safely during service Flexibility to work varying shifts, including evenings, weekends and public holidays as required What we offer Wet Plate Kitchen values its team members and provides a supportive working environment with opportunities for professional growth within the hospitality sector. We offer competitive compensation, meals during shifts, and a collaborative team culture that prioritises employee wellbeing. This contract position provides excellent experience in a Bali-based establishment, with potential for career development within our organisation. About us Wet Plate Kitchen is a hospitality company dedicated to delivering exceptional dining and guest experiences in Bali. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of service, quality and professionalism. Our team values integrity, teamwork and a genuine passion for hospitality. We create memorable experiences for our guests whilst fostering a positive and rewarding workplace for our staff. Apply now If you are an experienced Captain Waiter ready to make a significant impact on guest satisfaction and lead our service team to excellence, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in joining Wet Plate Kitchen.

  • Assist with pre-service and post-service duties, including table setup, stock management and closing procedures

  • Maintain knowledge of current promotions, menu changes and beverage selections to enhance guest recommendations

What we're looking for

  • Can join immediately

  • Minimum 3-5 years' experience as a waiter or captain waiter in a hotel, restaurant or upscale dining establishment

  • Proven ability to lead and motivate junior staff members in a fast-paced service environment

  • Excellent knowledge of food and beverage service standards, protocols and etiquette

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with guests from diverse backgrounds

  • Outstanding customer service orientation with a genuine commitment to exceeding guest expectations

  • Ability to remain calm, organised and composed during peak service periods

  • Proficiency in point-of-sale (POS) systems and reservation management software

  • Fluency in English required; additional languages such as Indonesian or Mandarin are advantageous

  • Physical ability to stand for extended periods and carry items safely during service

  • Flexibility to work varying shifts, including evenings, weekends and public holidays as required

What we offer

Wet Plate Kitchen values its team members and provides a supportive working environment with opportunities for professional growth within the hospitality sector. We offer competitive compensation, meals during shifts, and a collaborative team culture that prioritises employee wellbeing. This contract position provides excellent experience in a Bali-based establishment, with potential for career development within our organisation.

About us

Wet Plate Kitchen is a hospitality company dedicated to delivering exceptional dining and guest experiences in Bali. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of service, quality and professionalism. Our team values integrity, teamwork and a genuine passion for hospitality. We create memorable experiences for our guests whilst fostering a positive and rewarding workplace for our staff.

Apply now

If you are an experienced Captain Waiter ready to make a significant impact on guest satisfaction and lead our service team to excellence, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in joining Wet Plate Kitchen.

jobs.title: Purchasing Manager
jobs.description: Kami mencari Purchasing Manager yang energik, cepat beradaptasi, dan mampu memimpin tim untuk memastikan proses pengadaan berjalan efektif, efisien, dan mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis perusahaan. Job Summary Memimpin strategi dan operasional pembelian untuk memastikan ketersediaan material, efisiensi biaya, serta kelancaran koordinasi dengan supplier dan stakeholder internal. Kami mencari Purchasing Manager yang energik, cepat beradaptasi, dan mampu memimpin tim untuk memastikan proses pengadaan berjalan efektif, efisien, dan mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis perusahaan.

Job Summary

Memimpin strategi dan operasional pembelian untuk memastikan ketersediaan material, efisiensi biaya, serta kelancaran koordinasi dengan supplier dan stakeholder internal.

Tanggung Jawab

  • Mengelola proses pembelian dan pengadaan secara end-to-end

  • Menyusun strategi pengadaan yang efektif dan efisien

  • Membangun serta menjaga hubungan baik dengan supplier

  • Melakukan negosiasi harga, kontrak, dan persyaratan kerja sama

  • Memastikan ketersediaan material sesuai kebutuhan operasional

  • Mengawasi dan mengembangkan kinerja tim purchasing

  • Berkoordinasi dengan berbagai departemen untuk memastikan kebutuhan pengadaan terpenuhi tepat waktu

  • Melakukan monitoring, evaluasi, dan perbaikan proses procurement secara berkelanjutan


Kualifikasi

  • S1 dari semua jurusan

  • Berpengalaman sebagai Purchasing Manager/Assistant Manager/Head minimal 3 tahun

  • Memiliki jiwa kepemimpinan dan pengalaman memimpin tim dengan jumlah >5 orang

  • Berpengalaman menangani SKU material lebih dari 10 (di industri Manufaktur) / SKU >100 (di industri Trading)

  • Mahir dengan analisa dan data

  • Muda, energik, dan memiliki semangat belajar tinggi

  • Cepat tanggap dalam menangani permasalahan dan pengambilan keputusan

  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, koordinasi, dan negosiasi yang baik

  • Mampu bekerja secara kolaboratif dengan berbagai fungsi dalam perusahaan

  • Berorientasi pada hasil

  • Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas ke luar kota / luar pulau

  • Based penempatan di Surabaya

Kami Mencari Seseorang yang:

  • Bergerak cepat tanpa mengabaikan kualitas kerja

  • Mampu membangun kerja sama lintas departemen

  • Siap memimpin tim menuju performa yang lebih baik

  • Memiliki inisiatif tinggi

jobs.title: Cook
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami sedang mencari seorang Cook yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Kalpataru Coffee and Eatery di Bandung, Jawa Barat. Sebagai Cook, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mempersiapkan hidangan berkualitas tinggi dan menyajikan pengalaman kuliner yang luar biasa kepada pelanggan kami. Kandidat yang ideal memiliki keahlian masak yang kuat, kreativitas kuliner, dan komitmen terhadap layanan pelanggan yang unggul. Tanggung Jawab Mempersiapkan dan memasak berbagai menu masakan dengan konsistensi dan kualitas tinggi. Memastikan kebersihan dan keamanan area kerja dapur sesuai dengan standar kesehatan dan keselamatan. Bekerjasama dengan tim dapur untuk memastikan pengiriman pesanan yang cepat dan efisien. Terlibat dalam pengembangan dan pengujian menu baru untuk memperkaya penawaran kuliner kami. Menjaga standar kualitas makanan yang konsisten dan memenuhi harapan pelanggan. Mengikuti arahan dari Chef de Cuisine untuk memastikan proses persiapan dan penyajian berjalan lancar. Kualifikasi Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Cook di restoran, kafe, atau industri hospitaliti lainnya. Memiliki sertifikasi keamanan pangan yang valid. Memahami konsep-konsep dasar memasak, teknik penyajian, dan perencanaan menu. Memiliki kemampuan bekerja di bawah tekanan dan dalam lingkungan yang dinamis. Memiliki keterampilan komunikasi yang baik dan kemampuan bekerja dalam tim. Memiliki minat dan antusiasme dalam dunia kuliner. Manfaat Gaji kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman Pelatihan dan pengembangan profesional yang berkelanjutan Lingkungan kerja yang inovatif dan kolaboratif Kesempatan untuk berkreasi dan mengembangkan keterampilan kuliner Tentang Kalpataru Coffee and Eatery Kalpataru adalah kafe modern yang menawarkan pengalaman kuliner yang memukau di Bandung, Jawa Barat. Kami berkomitmen untuk menyajikan makanan berkualitas tinggi yang dibuat dengan bahan-bahan segar dan organik. Kami percaya pada keragaman dan inklusi, dan menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang mendukung, di mana semua orang memiliki kesempatan yang sama untuk berkembang dan berprestasi. Jika Anda tertarik untuk bergabung dengan tim kami yang dinamis, silakan lamar sekarang!

jobs.title: Operator QC Analyst
jobs.description: Kami adalah perusahaan manufaktur makanan (FMCG) yang terus berkembang dan berkomitmen menghadirkan produk berkualitas tinggi. Saat ini kami membuka kesempatan bagi kandidat terbaik untuk bergabung sebagai Operator QC Analyst . Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab : Melakukan pengujian kualitas bahan baku, proses produksi, dan produk jadi Melaksanakan analisa fisik, kimia, dan mikrobiologi sesuai standar Memastikan produk sesuai dengan spesifikasi mutu dan food safety Mengidentifikasi dan melaporkan ketidaksesuaian (non-conformance) Mendukung investigasi terkait produk reject dan komplain pelanggan Mendukung pelaksanaan audit internal dan eksternal (BPOM, Halal, ISO, dll) Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknologi Pangan, Kimia, Biologi, atau jurusan terkait Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai QC di industri makanan/minuman (FMCG diutamakan) Memahami GMP, HACCP, dan sistem keamanan pangan Mampu melakukan pengujian laboratorium (fisik, kimia, mikrobiologi) Teliti, detail-oriented, dan memiliki kemampuan analisa yang baik Mampu bekerja dalam tim Di utamakan berdomisili Banten (akan ada tes organoleptik di Perusahaan kami).

jobs.title: HVAC Account Executive (Mid Level)
jobs.description: Job Description: Melakukan aktivitas penjualan produk dan solusi HVAC kepada pelanggan baru maupun existing customer. Mencari, mengembangkan, dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan kontraktor, developer, konsultan, owner project, serta pelanggan industri. Mengidentifikasi peluang proyek dan melakukan follow up hingga proses closing. Menyusun dan mempresentasikan penawaran produk sesuai kebutuhan pelanggan. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Engineering, Technical Support, dan Project untuk memastikan kebutuhan pelanggan dapat terpenuhi. Melakukan negosiasi harga, spesifikasi, serta syarat komersial dengan klien. Memantau perkembangan proyek dari tahap tender, pengadaan, hingga implementasi. Menyusun laporan aktivitas penjualan, pipeline proyek, dan pencapaian target secara berkala. Melakukan analisis pasar dan kompetitor untuk mendukung strategi penjualan. Bertanggung jawab terhadap pencapaian target penjualan yang telah ditetapkan perusahaan. Job Specification: Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, Teknik Industri, Teknik Pendingin Tata Udara, atau jurusan terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Sales Engineer, Account Executive, Project Sales, atau posisi sejenis di bidang HVAC, MEP, Building Material, Industrial Equipment, atau bidang terkait. Memahami produk HVAC seperti AC komersial, Chiller, AHU, FCU, Ventilation System, atau produk sejenis menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, presentasi, dan negosiasi yang baik. Terbiasa melakukan kunjungan pelanggan dan pengembangan bisnis. Mampu membaca gambar teknik dan spesifikasi proyek menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki kemampuan analisa kebutuhan pelanggan dan penyusunan proposal penawaran. Menguasai Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Memiliki SIM A/C dan bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas. Berorientasi pada target dan hasil.
