jobs.title: Human Resources Analyst
jobs.description: About the role We are looking for an HR professional to manage our people operations and help build strong, scalable HR processes across the organization. Key responsibilities Manage day-to-day HR operations, including employee records, attendance, leave, onboarding, and offboarding. Draft and maintain employment contracts, HR documentation, policies, and SOPs. Ensure compliance with Indonesian labor regulations, BPJS Kesehatan, and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. Manage employee insurance, benefits administration, and related external providers. Handle employee relations and support management on workplace and disciplinary matters. Support performance reviews, employee development, and other people initiatives. Assist with recruitment and hiring activities when required. Continuously improve HR processes as the organization grows. About you Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Law, Management, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of HR experience, preferably in an HR Generalist or HR Operations role. Good understanding of Indonesian labor regulations, BPJS, and employment practices. Experience with employment contracts, HR policies, SOPs, and employee relations. Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Proactive, dependable, and able to work independently. High level of integrity when handling confidential information. Good command of English and Bahasa Indonesia. About us Skavana is a consumer-focused group that builds and invests in brands across industries that shape meaningful experiences. We are committed to enhancing consumer lives through high-quality products, services, and brands that connect deeply with their audiences.

jobs.title: Administrasi project
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami mencari seorang Administrasi Project yang terorganisir dan detail-oriented untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Tropikal Bali. Sebagai Administrasi Project, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mendukung kelancaran operasional berbagai proyek dengan mengelola dokumentasi, jadwal, dan komunikasi administratif. Posisi ini memerlukan individu yang proaktif, terampil dalam manajemen waktu, dan mampu bekerja efektif dalam lingkungan yang dinamis. Jabatan ini adalah posisi fulltime berbasis di South Denpasar, Bali, tempat Anda akan berkolaborasi langsung dengan tim project dan stakeholder internal untuk memastikan semua kebutuhan administratif terpenuhi dengan sempurna. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola dokumentasi project, termasuk pembuatan, penyimpanan, dan pembaruan file, proposal, dan laporan penting secara sistematis. Mengkoordinasikan jadwal meeting, appointment, dan timeline project untuk memastikan semua pihak terkait terinformasi dengan baik. Memproses dan mengorganisir data administratif, serta memastikan keakuratan informasi dalam sistem database perusahaan. Melakukan komunikasi administratif dengan klien, vendor, dan tim internal melalui email, telepon, dan platform komunikasi lainnya. Menyiapkan dan mengarsipkan dokumen project, kontrak, dan surat-surat penting sesuai prosedur perusahaan. Mendukung tim project dalam persiapan presentasi dan materi meeting yang diperlukan. Mencatat dan melaporkan progress project serta menyelesaikan tugas administratif dengan akurasi tinggi dan tepat waktu. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal Diploma (D3) atau setara dalam bidang Administrasi, Manajemen, Bisnis, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman kerja di bidang administrasi, dukungan office, atau project support. Penguasaan Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) dan keahlian dalam menggunakan software administrasi atau project management tools. Kemampuan komunikasi tertulis dan lisan yang sangat baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris. Keterampilan organisasi yang kuat dengan perhatian tinggi terhadap detail dan akurasi data. Kemampuan mengelola multiple tasks secara bersamaan dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan prioritas yang berubah. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan kualifikasi Anda. Cuti tahunan yang fleksibel dan hari libur sesuai dengan kebijakan perusahaan. Kesempatan pengembangan karier melalui program pelatihan dan workshop internal. Lingkungan kerja yang modern, mendukung, dan kolaboratif. Tunjangan transportasi dan keseimbangan work-life balance yang baik. Peluang untuk berkembang profesional bersama tim yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi. Tentang Kami Tropikal Bali adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan dan produk berkualitas tinggi kepada pelanggan kami. Dengan lokasi strategis di South Denpasar, Bali, kami telah membangun reputasi yang solid dalam industri kami. Perusahaan kami menjunjung tinggi nilai-nilai integritas, inovasi, dan customer excellence. Kami percaya bahwa setiap anggota tim memiliki kontribusi penting terhadap kesuksesan bersama, dan kami menciptakan budaya kerja yang mendukung pertumbuhan profesional, kolaborasi antar tim, dan inklusi. Bergabunglah dengan kami untuk menjadi bagian dari organisasi yang dinamis dan forward-thinking yang terus berkembang dan berinovasi. Lamar Sekarang Apakah Anda tertarik dengan posisi ini? Kami ingin mendengar dari Anda! Silakan kirimkan CV, surat motivasi, dan portfolio relevan Anda melalui portal karir kami atau email ke tim Human Resources kami. Jangan lewatkan kesempatan untuk bergabung dengan Tropikal Bali dan menjadi bagian dari tim yang luar biasa!

jobs.title: Fire Safety Officer
jobs.description: The Fire Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring effective fire prevention, protection, and emergency preparedness across the facility. This role focuses on maintaining fire safety systems and equipment, conducting fire risk assessments and emergency drills, providing fire safety training, and ensuring compliance with K3 and applicable fire safety regulations. The position also supports incident investigation, safety inspections, and continuous improvement to maintain a safe and emergency-ready working environment. Job Description Ensure implementation and compliance of fire safety policies, procedures, and applicable K3 regulations . Conduct Fire Risk Assessments and identify potential fire hazards across production, warehouse, utility, and office areas. Inspect and monitor fire alarm, detection, firefighting, and emergency response systems to ensure proper functionality and readiness. Coordinate preventive maintenance, testing, and inspection of fire protection equipment, including hydrants, sprinklers, fire pumps, extinguishers, and fire alarms. Develop and conduct emergency response, fire, and evacuation drills , including evaluation and corrective action follow-up. Provide fire safety training and emergency response awareness to employees, contractors, and emergency response teams. Monitor hot work, flammable materials, emergency exits, and other fire prevention controls across operational areas. Prepare fire safety reports, maintain inspection records, investigate incidents, and support HSE audits and continuous improvement programs . Complete required Annual Medical Check-Up (MCU) as part of the company's employment safety procedures and Occupational Health. Qualification : Bachelor's Degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field . Minimum 2 years of experience as a Safety/HSE Officer , preferably in FMCG, food, dairy, or manufacturing industries . Strong understanding of fire alarm, fire detection, firefighting, and emergency response systems . Experienced in Fire Risk Assessment, emergency response planning, and fire/evacuation drills . AK3 Umum and Fire Fighting/Fire Safety Certificate – Mandatory . Knowledge of Indonesian K3 and fire safety regulations , with ISO 45001 knowledge considered an advantage. Strong communication, leadership, problem-solving, and emergency decision-making skills , with willingness to work shifts. Proficient in English, both written and spoken, and willing to undergo the company's required MCU as part of the recruitment process. Willing to work daily on a rolling shift system, with working hours subject to operational requirements and tentative scheduling.

About the role

The Superintendent HSE Management System is responsible for implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving Integrated Management Systems covering ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMKP Minerba, Contractor Safety Management System (CSMS), and Corporate Safety Management Standards across operations and business partners. This role supervises the effective implementation of occupational health and safety programs, controls safety performance measurement, and ensures compliance with regulatory obligations and management system requirements.

Key responsibilities

  • Implement Industrial Hygiene and Occupational Health programs and Safety loss Control programs to prevent occupational illness and injury, ensuring health hazards are identified, evaluated and controlled

  • Control and optimize safety performance measurement through management of leading and lagging indicator data to produce accurate, relevant, and timely analysis for management decision-making

  • Analyze and evaluate OHS data, including incident investigation results and safety statistics, to identify risk trends, ensure control effectiveness, and improve safety management system maturity

  • Supervise, coordinate, and ensure effective implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of Integrated Management Systems covering ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMKP Minerba, CSMS, and PJO/Safety Officer Performance Management

  • Plan, organize, coordinate, and conduct internal audits, compliance audits, contractor audits, site assessments, management system evaluations, and assurance activities

  • Monitor, assess, evaluate, and verify compliance with applicable legal requirements, permit conditions, corporate standards, and management system requirements

  • Develop, monitor, analyze, and communicate HSES performance indicators, management system performance metrics, compliance reports, audit trends, and contractor HSE performance

  • Coordinate, monitor, and verify implementation of the Contractor Safety Management System including contractor risk classification, qualification, prequalification reviews, mobilization requirements, and performance monitoring

  • Coordinate and administer HSES Management System software platforms including and other supporting systems

  • Develop, maintain, review, and control the HSES Legal and Compliance Obligation Register covering regulatory requirements, permits, licenses, standards, codes of practice, and company requirements

About you

  • Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Occupational Health & Safety (K3), Industrial Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Mining Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Quality Management, Business Management, or other related disciplines

  • Master's Degree (S2) in HSE Management, Management Systems, Quality Management, Environmental Management, Risk Management, Engineering, or related field is an advantage

  • Lead Auditor Certification for ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMKP Minerba, or equivalent management system certifications is preferred

  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in mining, mineral processing, smelter operations, oil & gas, heavy industry, or other high-risk industries

  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in a superintendent, advisor, lead auditor, or management system leadership role

  • Proven experience in developing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving Integrated Management Systems (IMS)

  • Hands-on experience managing ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMKP Minerba, and Contractor Safety Management Systems (CSMS)

  • Experience coordinating internal audits, external audits, certification audits, regulatory inspections, and management review processes

  • Demonstrated experience in contractor HSE management programs, compliance monitoring, corrective action management, and continual improvement initiatives

  • Sound understanding of mining regulations, occupational health & safety regulations, environmental regulations, and Good Mining Practice requirements

OTA & Reservation Manage villa listings and reservations through OTA platforms such as Booking.com, Agoda, Airbnb, Expedia, etc. Monitor room availability, rates, promotions, and inventory. Respond to guest inquiries promptly and professionally. Handle booking confirmations, cancellations, modifications, and special requests. Maintain an accurate reservation calendar and prevent double bookings. Follow up with potential guests to convert inquiries into bookings. Prepare daily/weekly reservation reports. 2. Sales & Revenue Generate direct bookings through WhatsApp, Instagram, website, referrals, and other channels. Follow up leads and potential customers. Develop relationships with travel agents, tour operators, and local partners. Promote villa packages and special offers. Upsell additional services such as airport transfers, breakfast, BBQ, tours, transportation, etc. Achieve agreed monthly occupancy and revenue targets. Monitor competitor rates and market conditions. 3. Guest Relations & Concierge Communicate with guests before, during, and after their stay. Coordinate check-in and check-out arrangements. Assist guests with transportation, restaurant reservations, tours, activities, and other requests. Handle guest complaints professionally and coordinate solutions. Ensure guests receive a positive and personalized experience. Follow up on guest feedback and online reviews. 4. Villa Operations Conduct daily villa readiness and operational checks. Ensure the villa and public areas are clean, presentable, and guest-ready. Coordinate with Housekeeping, Maintenance, Garden, and Pool teams. Monitor amenities, linen, guest supplies, and operational inventory. Report maintenance issues and follow up on completion. Ensure operational standards are maintained. Assist management in implementing SOPs and improving guest experience. 5. Public Area Monitoring Monitor cleanliness and presentation of entrance, pool area, garden, terrace, parking area, and other public areas. Coordinate cleaning and maintenance requirements. Ensure all public areas are safe, clean, and ready for guests. Requirements Minimum education: SMA/SMK/Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Business, or related field. Minimum 1–2 years of experience in hotel, villa, resort, reservation, sales, or hospitality operations. Experience handling OTA platforms is preferred. Good knowledge of reservation processes and hospitality operations. Good communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English. Strong customer service and problem-solving skills. Comfortable using WhatsApp, email, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and basic Excel. Able to work independently with minimal supervision. Able to coordinate multiple operational tasks. Target-oriented and willing to work with sales targets. Well-groomed, professional, friendly, and service-oriented. Willing to work weekends, public holidays, and according to villa operational requirements. Having a valid driving license and own transportation is an advantage. Key Skills Must Have OTA management Reservation handling Guest communication Basic sales skills English communication Microsoft Office / Google Workspace Problem solving Operational coordination Preferred Booking.com / Agoda / Airbnb experience PMS experience Revenue management knowledge Travel agent/networking experience Social media and digital marketing knowledge Experience in villa operations

jobs.title: HUMAN CAPITAL MANAGER
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Human Capital Manager to lead and strengthen our people strategy while supporting business growth and operational excellence across the organization. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement Human Capital strategies aligned with business objectives and expansion plans. Lead workforce planning initiatives to ensure adequate manpower availability across business units and outlets. Oversee end-to-end Human Capital functions, including Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, Performance Management, Employee Relations, Industrial Relations, and HR Operations. Drive the implementation of performance management systems, KPI frameworks, talent development, and succession planning initiatives. Ensure payroll, employee administration, benefits, and labor compliance processes are executed accurately and efficiently. Build and strengthen organizational culture through employee engagement and culture development programs. Partner closely with operational leaders to improve workforce productivity, employee capability, and organizational effectiveness. Analyze people metrics and provide strategic recommendations to support management decision-making. Support new branch openings by ensuring manpower readiness, training readiness, and organizational setup. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Psychology, Management, Law, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in Human Resources / Human Capital. Minimum 2 years of experience in a Supervisor or Managerial role. Proven experience managing end-to-end HR functions, including: Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Payroll & HR Administration Performance Management Employee Relations & Industrial Relations Learning & Development Strong understanding of manpower planning, organizational development, HR policies, and labor regulations. Experience in hospitality, retail, wellness, F&B chain, or service-based businesses is highly preferred. Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills. Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate HR insights into business actions. Why Join Us? Opportunity to lead Human Capital transformation in a rapidly growing organization. Direct involvement in shaping organizational culture and people strategy. Dynamic and collaborative work environment. Significant exposure to business expansion and organizational development projects. Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both people and business performance.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description: About the role Develop and lead Sensatia's marketing strategy, annual marketing plan and campaign calendar in line with company growth objectives and brand direction. Lead integrated marketing planning and execution across brand communications, retail marketing, product launches, events, partnerships and other customer-facing initiatives. Key responsibilities Develop and lead Sensatia's marketing strategy, annual marketing plan and campaign calendar in line with company growth objectives and brand direction. Lead integrated marketing planning and execution across brand communications, retail marketing, product launches, events, partnerships and other customer-facing initiatives. Develop, own and manage the Marketing budget within the overall Commercial plan, ensuring disciplined allocation of resources and measurable commercial and brand outcomes. Strengthen Sensatia's brand positioning and ensure consistent brand expression across all customer touchpoints. Translate company and commercial objectives into clear marketing priorities, campaigns and execution plans. Work closely with Digital Marketing, Creative, E-Commerce, Sales, Retail Operations and Visual Merchandising to deliver coordinated commercial initiatives. Establish clear objectives and KPIs for marketing activities, evaluate performance and continuously improve marketing effectiveness and ROI. Use customer, market, competitive and commercial insights to identify opportunities and inform marketing decisions. Lead, coach and develop the Marketing team, creating clear accountability and building stronger marketing capabilities. About you Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of relevant marketing experience, including experience leading and developing a team. Strong consumer-brand marketing experience; beauty, skincare, personal care, FMCG, lifestyle, retail or premium consumer-brand experience is preferred. Strong understanding of brand strategy, consumer marketing and commercial marketing. Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns and managing meaningful marketing budgets. jobs.title: Finance Accounting Tax Superintendent - Tambang / Sawit/Konstruksi
jobs.description: URAIAN TUGAS DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB : 1. Perusahaan Pertambangan Tugas FAT Superintendent di sektor tambang sangat berfokus pada efisiensi biaya operasional alat berat, perizinan Royalti/PNBP, serta pengawasan biaya di area site/site office. Finance & Cost Control Pengendalian Cost per Ton : Mengendalikan biaya operasional penambangan (BBM, perawatan unit, suku cadang alat berat, dan subcontractor/hauling ). Kas Site & Head Office: Mengelola dana operasional lapangan ( petty cash site ) serta pengajuan pencairan dana berkala ke HO. Accounting Akuntansi Tambang & Aset: Mengelola pencatatan penyusutan alat berat, akuisisi lahan, biaya eksplorasi/eksploitasi, serta rekapitulasi persediaan ( stockpile inventory ). Rekonsiliasi Produksi: Mencocokkan data pencatatan transaksi akuntansi dengan laporan ritase/overburden (OB) dan penjualan kargo dari tim operasional/geologi. Taxation & Compliance Pajak & Retribusi Daerah: Mengelola kewajiban PPh Pasal 22 impor, PPh Pasal 23 jasa tambang/alat berat, PPN, Pajak Bahan Bakar (PBBKB), serta Pajak Air Tanah/Permukaan. Kepatuhan PNBP & Royalti: Memastikan perhitungan dan pembayaran Royalti (PNBP tambang) sesuai dengan harga patokan komoditas resmi pemerintah. 2. Perusahaan Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit (Agribisnis/PKS) Fokus utama di industri sawit mencakup akuntansi biologis (kebun), pengeluaran Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), serta penanganan skema kemitraan plasma. Finance Arus Kas Musim Panen: Mengatur ketersediaan kas harian untuk pembelian Tandan Buah Segar (TBS) dari pihak ketiga/petani luar dan pengadaan pupuk skala besar. Manajemen Pembayaran Plasma: Memantau perhitungan dan pencairan dana bagi hasil untuk kebun kemitraan (Plasma/KUD). Accounting Akuntansi Aset Biologis (PSAK 69): Menghitung dan mencatat nilai wajar Tanaman Belum Menghasilkan (TBM) hingga menjadi Tanaman Menghasilkan (TM). HPP & Stok Minyak Sawit: Menghitung Biaya Pokok Produksi (HPP) Crude Palm Oil (CPO) dan Palm Kernel (PK) serta melakukan kontrol atas penyusutan stok di tangki timbun ( CPO storage tank ). Taxation Restitusi PPN: Mengelola pengajuan restitusi PPN secara rutin karena karakter usaha ekspor atau penyerahan CPO yang memicu lebih bayar. Pajak Khusus Perkebunan: Mengurus perhitungan Bea Keluar/Pungutan Ekspor CPO, PPh 22 Pembelian TBS dari Petani, serta PBB Sektor Perkebunan. 3. Perusahaan Konstruksi & Kontraktor FAT Superintendent di sektor konstruksi bertanggung jawab penuh terhadap akuntansi proyek, cash flow per proyek, serta penanganan potongan/retensi pembayaran. Finance Cash Flow Proyek: Memantau likuiditas untuk mendukung pembelian material, operasional subkontraktor, dan pembayaran upah tenaga kerja harian/borongan. Manajemen Penagihan (Termin): Menyusun dan memantau klaim penagihan ke pemilik proyek ( owner/client ) berdasarkan progres fisik. Accounting Akuntansi Kontrak Konstruksi (PSAK 72): Mengakui pendapatan dan beban berdasarkan persentase penyelesaian proyek ( percentage of completion method ). Pencatatan Retensi & WIP: Mengawasi pencatatan dana retensi proyek (yang ditahan client hingga masa pemeliharaan selesai) dan barang Work in Progress (WIP). Taxation PPh Final Jasa Konstruksi: Memastikan tarif PPh Final Pasal 4 ayat (2) diterapkan secara benar sesuai dengan Sertifikat Badan Usaha (SBU)/Kualifikasi Jasa Konstruksi yang dimiliki. PPN & Faktur Proyek: Memastikan e-Faktur diterbitkan sesuai saat terutang (saat pembayaran termin atau penyerahan progres) serta mencocokkan pajak masukan material bangunan. KUALFIKASI : Kualifikasi FAT Superintendent terbagi menjadi kualifikasi umum (keahlian mendasar) dan kualifikasi spesifik berdasarkan sektor industrinya. Kualifikasi Umum (General Requirements) Pendidikan: S1 Akuntansi / Keuangan / Manajemen Keuangan dari perguruan tinggi terkemuka. Pengalaman: Minimal 5–7 tahun di bidang FAT, dengan minimal 2–3 tahun pada posisi tingkat manajerial ( Supervisor , Assistant Manager , atau Superintendent ). Sertifikasi Profesional: Diutamakan memiliki sertifikasi Brevet A & B, CA ( Chartered Accountant ), atau CPA ( Certified Public Accountant ). Software Keuangan & ERP: Mahir menggunakan sistem ERP terintegrasi (seperti SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, atau Microsoft Dynamics 365) serta aplikasi perpajakan (e-Faktur, e-SPT, Coretax). Keahlian Manajerial: Memiliki kepemimpinan yang kuat, analisis keuangan ( financial modeling/analytical thinking ), pemecahan masalah, dan kemampuan komunikasi interpersonal. Kualifikasi Spesifik per Industri 1. Industri Pertambangan Pengalaman Sektor: Wajib berpengalaman di perusahaan tambang (batu bara, nikel, atau mineral lainnya) dan siap ditempatkan di site office (sistem kerja roster ). Regulasi & PNBP: Menguasai regulasi perpajakan sektor pertambangan, perhitungan PNBP (Royalti Tambang), PBBKB, dan Pajak Air Tanah. Manajemen Biaya Operasional: Memahami analisis Cost per Ton , manajemen persediaan stockpile , serta akuntansi aset berat dan akuisisi lahan. 2. Perusahaan Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit (Agribisnis/PKS) Pengalaman Sektor: Memiliki rekam jejak di perusahaan kelapa sawit yang mencakup operasional kebun ( estate ) maupun Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS). Standar Akuntansi: Menguasai PSAK 69 (Aset Biologis/Tanaman Belum Menghasilkan & Tanaman Menghasilkan) dan perhitungan HPP CPO/Kernel. Kepatuhan Pajak Khusus: Terbiasa menangani pengajuan restitusi PPN (ekspor/lokal), Bea Keluar CPO, PBB Sektor Perkebunan, dan PPh 22 atas pembelian TBS dari mitra/plasma. 3. Perusahaan Konstruksi & Kontraktor Pengalaman Sektor: Berpengalaman di perusahaan kontraktor general, infrastruktur, atau EPC ( Engineering, Procurement, Construction ). Akuntansi Kontrak: Memahami pengakuan pendapatan berdasarkan metode Percentage of Completion (PSAK 72), penanganan Work in Progress (WIP), dan retensi proyek. Perpajakan Konstruksi: Menguasai ketentuan PPh Final Jasa Konstruksi (Pasal 4 ayat 2) berdasarkan Kualifikasi/SBU perusahaan dan regulasi perpajakan proyek multi-tahun ( multi-years contract ).

analisis potensi lokasi kerja sama baru dengan menyesuaikan profil dan kebutuhan tamu berdasarkan negara asal yang berkunjung ke galeri Menyusun dan mengelola dokumen kerja sama (kontrak/MoU) antara untuk meningkatkan kunjungan tamu ke galeri Menyiapkan dan melengkapi marketing kit (materi promosi, informasi produk, dan pendukung kerja sama) untuk kebutuhan mitra Berkoordinasi dengan tim galeri, kasir, dan marketing terkait data transaksi dan program kerja sama Menyusun laporan berkala terkait kerja sama, kunjungan guide, dan performa mitra Melaksanakan tugas lain yang berkaitan dengan fungsi kemitraan sesuai arahan atasan Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK, diutamakan D3/S1 bidang Pariwisata, Perhotelan, Marketing, atau Komunikasi Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang jobs.title: sales supervisor
jobs.company: BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN (PT. BUMI HIJAU MOTOR)
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari seorang Sales Supervisor yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim penjualan kami di BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN (PT. BUMI HIJAU MOTOR) di Samarinda, Kalimantan Timur. Sebagai Sales Supervisor, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memimpin tim penjualan, mencapai target penjualan, dan memastikan kepuasan pelanggan yang optimal. Posisi ini membutuhkan profesional yang memiliki kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat, pemahaman mendalam tentang strategi penjualan, dan motivasi tinggi untuk mendorong pertumbuhan bisnis. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi fulltime yang berbasis di Samarinda, Kalimantan Timur, dengan peluang pengembangan karier yang menjanjikan di industri otomotif yang terus berkembang. Tanggung Jawab Memimpin, mengawasi, dan mengelola tim penjualan untuk mencapai target penjualan bulanan dan tahunan yang telah ditetapkan. Merencanakan dan mengimplementasikan strategi penjualan yang efektif untuk meningkatkan volume penjualan dan pangsa pasar. Memberikan coaching, pelatihan, dan bimbingan kepada anggota tim penjualan untuk meningkatkan keterampilan dan kinerja mereka. Memantau kinerja tim secara berkelanjutan melalui analisis data penjualan dan memberikan feedback konstruktif untuk perbaikan berkelanjutan. Mengelola hubungan dengan pelanggan kunci dan memastikan tingkat kepuasan pelanggan yang tinggi melalui layanan purna jual yang excellent. Melakukan presentasi produk dan negosiasi dengan calon pelanggan untuk menutup penjualan yang signifikan. Membuat laporan penjualan terperinci dan menganalisis trend pasar untuk memberikan insight kepada manajemen. Mengoordinasikan dengan departemen lain seperti operasional dan layanan pelanggan untuk memastikan pengalaman pelanggan yang seamless. Merekrut, menyeleksi, dan mengembangkan talenta baru untuk tim penjualan. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal SMA/SMK sederajat, lebih baik jika memiliki Diploma atau Gelar Sarjana dalam bidang Bisnis, Manajemen, Penjualan, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 3-5 tahun pengalaman di bidang penjualan dengan pengalaman khusus dalam manajemen tim atau kepemimpinan. Pengalaman yang terbukti dalam industri otomotif atau penjualan produk high-value merupakan nilai tambah yang signifikan. Kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat dengan keterampilan manajemen tim yang excellent dan mampu memotivasi tim mencapai target. Penguasaan teknik penjualan, negosiasi, dan closing yang matang serta customer relationship management. Kemampuan analisis data yang baik untuk mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan penjualan dan mengoptimalkan strategi. Keterampilan komunikasi yang luar biasa baik dalam presentasi maupun dalam membangun hubungan interpersonal. Pemahaman tentang target market dan segmentasi pelanggan serta kemampuan mengidentifikasi peluang cross-selling dan upselling. Kemauan untuk bekerja di bawah tekanan dengan deadline yang ketat sambil mempertahankan kualitas pekerjaan. Integritas tinggi, profesionalisme, dan dedikasi terhadap pencapaian target dan kepuasan pelanggan. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif dan tunjangan kinerja berdasarkan pencapaian target penjualan. Bonus insentif menarik untuk pencapaian target dan kinerja tim yang exceeds expectations. Asuransi kesehatan komprehensif untuk Anda dan keluarga dengan coverage yang luas. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional, kolaboratif, dan mendukung inovasi dalam strategi penjualan. Akses ke produk dan teknologi terkini dari BYD, salah satu produsen kendaraan listrik terdepan di dunia. Kesempatan untuk bekerja dengan brand ternama dan berbagai benefit karyawan lainnya sesuai dengan kebijakan perusahaan. Tentang Kami BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN (PT. BUMI HIJAU MOTOR) adalah distributor resmi produk BYD, salah satu produsen kendaraan listrik dan solusi energi terbarukan terkemuka di dunia. Perusahaan kami berkomitmen untuk membawa inovasi teknologi otomotif canggih dan ramah lingkungan ke pasar Indonesia, khususnya di kawasan Kalimantan. Dengan fokus pada keberlanjutan, kualitas produk, dan kepuasan pelanggan, BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN terus berkembang dan memperluas jangkauan bisnis di wilayah timur Indonesia. Kami percaya bahwa tim yang termotivasi, profesional, dan berpengalaman adalah kunci kesuksesan kami. Kami menyediakan lingkungan kerja yang mendorong kreativitas, inovasi, dan pertumbuhan profesional bagi setiap karyawan. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki passion dalam penjualan, kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat, dan tertarik untuk berkembang bersama BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN, kami sangat ingin mendengar dari Anda. Silakan lamar sekarang dengan mengirimkan CV, surat motivasi, dan referensi profesional Anda kepada tim Human Resources kami. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan jadilah bagian dari revolusi transportasi berkelanjutan di Indonesia!

  • Memantau kinerja tim secara berkelanjutan melalui analisis data penjualan dan memberikan feedback konstruktif untuk perbaikan berkelanjutan.

  • Mengelola hubungan dengan pelanggan kunci dan memastikan tingkat kepuasan pelanggan yang tinggi melalui layanan purna jual yang excellent.

  • Melakukan presentasi produk dan negosiasi dengan calon pelanggan untuk menutup penjualan yang signifikan.

  • Membuat laporan penjualan terperinci dan menganalisis trend pasar untuk memberikan insight kepada manajemen.

  • Mengoordinasikan dengan departemen lain seperti operasional dan layanan pelanggan untuk memastikan pengalaman pelanggan yang seamless.

  • Merekrut, menyeleksi, dan mengembangkan talenta baru untuk tim penjualan.

Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan

  • Minimal SMA/SMK sederajat, lebih baik jika memiliki Diploma atau Gelar Sarjana dalam bidang Bisnis, Manajemen, Penjualan, atau bidang terkait.

  • Minimal 3-5 tahun pengalaman di bidang penjualan dengan pengalaman khusus dalam manajemen tim atau kepemimpinan.

  • Pengalaman yang terbukti dalam industri otomotif atau penjualan produk high-value merupakan nilai tambah yang signifikan.

  • Kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat dengan keterampilan manajemen tim yang excellent dan mampu memotivasi tim mencapai target.

  • Penguasaan teknik penjualan, negosiasi, dan closing yang matang serta customer relationship management.

  • Kemampuan analisis data yang baik untuk mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan penjualan dan mengoptimalkan strategi.

  • Keterampilan komunikasi yang luar biasa baik dalam presentasi maupun dalam membangun hubungan interpersonal.

  • Pemahaman tentang target market dan segmentasi pelanggan serta kemampuan mengidentifikasi peluang cross-selling dan upselling.

  • Kemauan untuk bekerja di bawah tekanan dengan deadline yang ketat sambil mempertahankan kualitas pekerjaan.

  • Integritas tinggi, profesionalisme, dan dedikasi terhadap pencapaian target dan kepuasan pelanggan.

Manfaat Utama Perusahaan

  • Gaji yang kompetitif dan tunjangan kinerja berdasarkan pencapaian target penjualan.

  • Bonus insentif menarik untuk pencapaian target dan kinerja tim yang exceeds expectations.

  • Asuransi kesehatan komprehensif untuk Anda dan keluarga dengan coverage yang luas.

  • Lingkungan kerja yang profesional, kolaboratif, dan mendukung inovasi dalam strategi penjualan.

  • Akses ke produk dan teknologi terkini dari BYD, salah satu produsen kendaraan listrik terdepan di dunia.

  • Kesempatan untuk bekerja dengan brand ternama dan berbagai benefit karyawan lainnya sesuai dengan kebijakan perusahaan.

Tentang Kami
BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN (PT. BUMI HIJAU MOTOR) adalah distributor resmi produk BYD, salah satu produsen kendaraan listrik dan solusi energi terbarukan terkemuka di dunia. Perusahaan kami berkomitmen untuk membawa inovasi teknologi otomotif canggih dan ramah lingkungan ke pasar Indonesia, khususnya di kawasan Kalimantan. Dengan fokus pada keberlanjutan, kualitas produk, dan kepuasan pelanggan, BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN terus berkembang dan memperluas jangkauan bisnis di wilayah timur Indonesia. Kami percaya bahwa tim yang termotivasi, profesional, dan berpengalaman adalah kunci kesuksesan kami. Kami menyediakan lingkungan kerja yang mendorong kreativitas, inovasi, dan pertumbuhan profesional bagi setiap karyawan.

Lamar Sekarang
Jika Anda memiliki passion dalam penjualan, kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat, dan tertarik untuk berkembang bersama BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN, kami sangat ingin mendengar dari Anda. Silakan lamar sekarang dengan mengirimkan CV, surat motivasi, dan referensi profesional Anda kepada tim Human Resources kami. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan jadilah bagian dari revolusi transportasi berkelanjutan di Indonesia!

jobs.title: Front Office
jobs.description: Job Description Menyambut dan melayani pelanggan dengan ramah, profesional, serta memberikan pengalaman yang positif sesuai standar pelayanan SUNSRI Jewelry. Memberikan informasi mengenai produk, layanan, promo, dan kebijakan perusahaan kepada pelanggan. Melakukan follow-up kepada pelanggan terkait pesanan, pembayaran, pengambilan barang, maupun layanan purna jual (after-sales service). Menangani pertanyaan, permintaan, serta keluhan pelanggan dengan profesional dan memberikan solusi sesuai prosedur perusahaan. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Gallery, Produksi, Inventory, dan divisi terkait untuk memastikan kebutuhan pelanggan terpenuhi dengan baik. Membantu proses administrasi operasional, termasuk pengarsipan dokumen dan penyusunan laporan harian. Memastikan area Front Office selalu bersih, rapi, nyaman, dan siap menyambut pelanggan. Menjaga kerahasiaan data pelanggan dan informasi perusahaan. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK sederajat. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Front Office, Customer Service, Receptionist, atau posisi sejenis (fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar apabila memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik). Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, pelayanan pelanggan, dan interpersonal yang baik. Berpenampilan rapi, sopan, dan profesional. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, dan Outlook) serta komputer dengan baik. Mampu berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa Indonesia dengan baik; kemampuan berbahasa Inggris, baik lisan maupun tulisan, menjadi nilai tambah. Teliti, disiplin, ramah, bertanggung jawab, serta mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Memiliki kemampuan problem solving, multitasking, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. Diutamakan berdomisili di Gianyar, Denpasar dan sekitarnya Benefits Salary kompetitif. Meal & Transport Allowance. BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan. THR sesuai ketentuan perusahaan. Bonus/insentif berdasarkan kinerja. Kesempatan mengikuti pelatihan dan pengembangan diri. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional, suportif, dan dinamis. Peluang pengembangan karier di SUNSRI Jewelry.

High level of drive and determination Good Interpersonal, influencing and negotiation skills Desirable for the role Insightful Patient and Customer Journeys Able to Thinks Strategically Able to work in Agile Working environment Has ability to Influence and inspire others Why join AstraZeneca? At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare. Location Yogyakarta, Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia Job ID R-258618 Date posted 20/08/2026

Do you have expertise in, and passion for Sales? Would you like to apply your expertise to impact the lives of patients in a company that follows the science and turns ideas into life changing medicines? Then AstraZeneca might be the one for you!

ABOUT ASTRAZENECA

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialisation of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies. We are on a journey to bring life-saving medicines to patients. Our role in contributing to decreasing mortality rates globally is clear – shaping the future by spotting a scientifically-led commercial opportunity and acting now to operationalise and scale it.

What you’ll do

Oncology Account Specialist would be responsible to develop territory and build strong customer relationships with the objective of maximizing sales volume and market share of oncology products on a given territory.

The job responsibilities includes:

  • Effectively implement sales strategy and tactics, plan of action (POA) in accordance with company policies

  • Regularly monitor territory’s sales performance to initiate appropriate actions to ensure performance is in line with objectives

  • Conduct analysis of market/competitors to identify territory business opportunities

  • Develop territory Business Plan based on POA and allocate resources (e.g. call activities, budget), for optimal sales impact

  • Monitor territory business plan to ensure resources are directed to customers of greatest potential

  • Participate in sales activities programs to increase product awareness in the market

  • Update territory customer segmentation classification, database and call records continuously

  • Explore and expand new customer base in line with SFE guidelines

  • Deliver key promotional messages within approved detail aids and in line with POA

  • Build trust and credibility with customers by demonstrating professionalism acting within the AZ Code of Conduct

  • Submit Monthly reports commenting on deviations from Business Plan and intended actions to align performance with objectives

  • Ensure punctual delivery of report

  • Develop behaviours leading to enhanced effectiveness as outlined in MR Competency definitions.

  • Identify areas for self-development and discuss developmental needs with FLSM

  • Attend & actively participate in sales meetings, product and sales training

  • Acts as a mentor/buddy/coach as project based (to support FLSMs) i.e :reps with lower performance, new reps in field introduction

Essential for the role

  • Bachelor Degree in any field, preferably science-related

  • Experience in Sales function, esp in Oncology Therapy Area.

  • High level of drive and determination

  • Good Interpersonal, influencing and negotiation skills

Desirable for the role

  • Insightful Patient and Customer Journeys

  • Able to Thinks Strategically

  • Able to work in Agile Working environment

  • Has ability to Influence and inspire others

Why join AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.

  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available and we hope it’s yours.

  • If you’re curious to know more then please reach out to Evita Rinaldy. We welcome your application.

jobs.title: General Manager Legal Corporate- Holding Company
jobs.description: Tugas Utama & Tanggung Jawab : Manajemen & Strategi Hukum: Merumuskan strategi hukum perusahaan, memberikan nasehat hukum ( legal advice ) kepada direksi/manajemen, serta memastikan seluruh operasional bisnis sejalan dengan regulasi pemerintah. Penyusunan & Peninjauan Kontrak ( Legal Drafting & Review ): Memimpin pembuatan, pemeriksaan, dan negosiasi semua perjanjian kerja sama, kontrak bisnis (lokal maupun internasional), serta dokumen legalitas lainnya. Kepatuhan Regulasi & Tata Kelola ( Corporate Governance ): Memastikan perusahaan mematuhi seluruh perundang-undangan ( compliance ), mengurus perizinan badan usaha, serta menerapkan prinsip Good Corporate Governance (GCG). Manajemen Sengketa & Litigasi ( Litigation & Dispute Resolution ): Menangani sengketa hukum, klaim, atau tuntutan terhadap perusahaan; serta berkoordinasi dengan pengacara/konsultan hukum eksternal jika kasus masuk ke ranah pengadilan. Corporate Action & Transaksi Strategis: Menangani aspek hukum terkait tindakan korporasi seperti akuisisi, merger, restrukturisasi perusahaan, penanaman modal, atau penerbitan saham/obligasi. Manajemen Tim & Aset Legal: Memimpin dan mengembangkan tim legal , serta mengelola dokumen dan lisensi legalitas perusahaan ( corporate secretary & legal documentation ). Kualifikasi : 1. Pendidikan & Sertifikasi Pendidikan Minimal: S1 Hukum (S.H.) dari universitas dengan reputasi baik. Gelar S2 (Magister Hukum/LL.M. atau MM/MBA) menjadi nilai tambah yang signifikan. Memiliki Lisensi / Sertifikasi Professional, menjadi nilai tambah : Lisensi Advokat aktif (PERADI atau organisasi advokat resmi lainnya) Sertifikasi Kepatuhan (Certified Legal Compliance Professional) atau Konsultan Hukum Pasar Modal, lebih disukai. 2. Pengalaman Kerja Pengalaman Minimum: Minimum 10–12 tahun pengalaman di bidang hukum bisnis (corporate legal). Pengalaman Manajerial: Minimum 3–5 tahun di posisi tingkat manajerial puncak (seperti Legal Manager, Head of Legal, atau Senior Legal Counsel). Pengalaman Kombinasi: Pengalaman bekerja di law firm terkemuka (sebagai Senior Associate atau Partner) dan/atau internal in-house counsel di perusahaan multinasional/korporasi besar sangat diutamakan. 3. Keahlian Teknis (Hard Skills) Keahlian Hukum Bisnis & Kontrak: Menguasai legal drafting, analisis kontrak komersial kompleks (lokal dan internasional), serta teknik negosiasi bisnis. Hukum Korporasi & Transaksi Strategis: Paham mendalam tentang Corporate Governance (GCG), UU PT, hukum perizinan, pertanahan/aset, serta proses Merger & Acquisition (M&A) atau corporate restructuring. Litigasi & Resolusi Sengketa: Memahami hukum acara dan strategi penanganan sengketa hukum (litigation dan arbitration). Kepatuhan Regulasi (Compliance): Menguasai regulasi spesifik industri tempat perusahaan bergerak (misalnya: perbankan/fintech, energi, manufaktur, atau ritel). Bahasa: Fasih berbahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris (lisan & tulisan) untuk kebutuhan negosiasi dan pembuatan dokumen hukum internasional. 4. Keterampilan Interpersonal & Kepemimpinan (Soft Skills) Strategic & Business Acumen: Mampu melihat masalah hukum dari sudut pandang bisnis dan memberikan solusi legal yang pragmatis tanpa menghambat pertumbuhan bisnis. Leadership & Team Management: Mampu memimpin, membimbing, dan mengembangkan tim hukum korporasi. Risk Management: Ketajaman dalam mengidentifikasi, menganalisis, dan memitigasi risiko hukum sejak dini. Problem Solving & Communication: Keterampilan komunikasi yang persuasive serta kemampuan mengambil keputusan dalam situasi krisis atau sengketa.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description: KESEMPATAN CV BUMINET PRAKARSA' mencari Key Account Manager yang berpengalaman dan dinamis untuk bergabung dengan tim penjualan kami di Bali. Sebagai Key Account Manager, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengelola dan mengembangkan hubungan dengan klien-klien kunci perusahaan. Posisi ini memerlukan profesional yang mampu mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan, membangun kepercayaan jangka panjang dengan klien, dan memastikan kepuasan pelanggan yang optimal. Anda akan bekerja secara penuh waktu dari lokasi Bali, dengan tanggung jawab mengelola portofolio akun bernilai tinggi dan berkontribusi langsung pada pertumbuhan pendapatan perusahaan. TUGAS DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB Membangun dan menjaga hubungan jangka panjang dengan klien strategis. Mencapai target penjualan dan profit dengan klien Mengelola distribusi, stok dan ketersediaan produk Menjalankan program promosi dan meningkatkan sell out Menganalisis penjualan, aktivitas kompetitor, dan peluang pasar Menjalin hubungan baik dengan dealer dan mitra bisnis Menyusun laporan, forecasting dan action plan KUALIFIKASI Pendidikan min S1 Pengalaman min 5 thn dibidang sales,dengan pengalaman memimpin tim Memahami distribusi, retail dan strategi penjualan Memiliki kemampuan analisis dan negoisasi Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas Menguasai Microsoft Office SKILL UTAMA Key Account Management Leadership Sales Management Business & Data Analysis Negotiation & Team Development Communication & Presentation Problem Solving Planning & Execution Customer & Market Orientation Tentang Kami CV BUMINET PRAKARSA' adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi bisnis berkualitas tinggi kepada klien-klien kami di seluruh Indonesia. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri, kami telah membangun reputasi sebagai mitra bisnis yang terpercaya dan inovatif. Perusahaan kami mengutamakan integritas, profesionalisme, dan kepuasan pelanggan dalam setiap aspek operasional. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan kami terletak pada tim yang berdedikasi, berbakat, dan berbisnis dengan nilai-nilai etika yang kuat. Bali menjadi hub operasional kami yang strategis, memungkinkan kami untuk melayani klien dengan lebih baik dan menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inspiratif. Kami terus berinovasi dan berkembang, menciptakan peluang karier yang bermakna bagi profesional berbakat yang ingin berkontribusi pada pertumbuhan bersama. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda adalah Key Account Manager yang berpengalaman, strategis, dan passionate dalam membangun hubungan klien yang kuat, kami mengundang Anda untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan portfolio pencapaian penjualan Anda kepada kami. KESEMPATAN

CV BUMINET PRAKARSA' mencari Key Account Manager yang berpengalaman dan dinamis untuk bergabung dengan tim penjualan kami di Bali. Sebagai Key Account Manager, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengelola dan mengembangkan hubungan dengan klien-klien kunci perusahaan. Posisi ini memerlukan profesional yang mampu mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan, membangun kepercayaan jangka panjang dengan klien, dan memastikan kepuasan pelanggan yang optimal. Anda akan bekerja secara penuh waktu dari lokasi Bali, dengan tanggung jawab mengelola portofolio akun bernilai tinggi dan berkontribusi langsung pada pertumbuhan pendapatan perusahaan.

TUGAS DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB

  1. Membangun dan menjaga hubungan jangka panjang dengan klien strategis.

  2. Mencapai target penjualan dan profit dengan klien

  3. Mengelola distribusi, stok dan ketersediaan produk

  4. Menjalankan program promosi dan meningkatkan sell out

  5. Menganalisis penjualan, aktivitas kompetitor, dan peluang pasar

  6. Menjalin hubungan baik dengan dealer dan mitra bisnis

  7. Menyusun laporan, forecasting dan action plan

KUALIFIKASI

  1. Pendidikan min S1

  2. Pengalaman min 5 thn dibidang sales,dengan pengalaman memimpin tim

  3. Memahami distribusi, retail dan strategi penjualan

  4. Memiliki kemampuan analisis dan negoisasi

  5. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas

  6. Menguasai Microsoft Office


SKILL UTAMA

  1. Key Account Management

  2. Leadership

  3. Sales Management

  4. Business & Data Analysis

  5. Negotiation & Team Development

  6. Communication & Presentation

  7. Problem Solving

  8. Planning & Execution

  9. Customer & Market Orientation

Tentang Kami

CV BUMINET PRAKARSA' adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi bisnis berkualitas tinggi kepada klien-klien kami di seluruh Indonesia. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri, kami telah membangun reputasi sebagai mitra bisnis yang terpercaya dan inovatif. Perusahaan kami mengutamakan integritas, profesionalisme, dan kepuasan pelanggan dalam setiap aspek operasional. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan kami terletak pada tim yang berdedikasi, berbakat, dan berbisnis dengan nilai-nilai etika yang kuat. Bali menjadi hub operasional kami yang strategis, memungkinkan kami untuk melayani klien dengan lebih baik dan menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inspiratif. Kami terus berinovasi dan berkembang, menciptakan peluang karier yang bermakna bagi profesional berbakat yang ingin berkontribusi pada pertumbuhan bersama.

Lamar Sekarang


Jika Anda adalah Key Account Manager yang berpengalaman, strategis, dan passionate dalam membangun hubungan klien yang kuat, kami mengundang Anda untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan portfolio pencapaian penjualan Anda kepada kami. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda lebih baik dan membahas bagaimana Anda dapat berkontribusi pada kesuksesan CV BUMINET PRAKARSA'.

About the role

Pisang Madu Pasti (PMP) is looking for a detail-oriented, disciplined, and quality-focused Staff Quality Control to ensure that product quality, food safety, cleanliness, and operational standards are consistently maintained across our outlets. You will conduct monitoring and inspection regularly to ensure all outlets implement SOP, product quality standards, cleanliness, and food safety according to PMP standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Conduct quality control and inspection routinely at outlets

  • Ensure product quality meets established standards by checking taste, texture, appearance, size, and presentation

  • Verify food safety, hygiene, and sanitation implementation at outlets

  • Check cleanliness of production areas, equipment, storage, and service areas

  • Ensure raw material storage complies with FIFO/FEFO standards and applicable regulations

  • Check condition, quality, and expiration dates of raw materials

  • Ensure employees follow production, handling, storage, and cleanliness SOPs

  • Record inspection findings and prepare QC reports

  • Provide corrective action recommendations for outlet findings and follow up until standards are met

  • Coordinate with Operation, Production, and Outlet teams regarding quality improvements

About you

  • Minimum D3/S1 degree in Food Technology, Culinary Arts, Nutrition, Biology, Chemistry, or related field

  • Fresh graduates welcome; experience as QC in F&B is a plus

  • Understanding of Quality Control basics, Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

  • Understanding of FIFO/FEFO principles, raw material storage, and food handling

  • Detail-oriented, disciplined, assertive, with strong observation skills

  • Able to identify problems and provide improvement recommendations

  • Good communication and coordination abilities

  • Able to prepare inspection reports neatly

  • Able to work independently and in a team

  • Willing to conduct visits/inspections to outlets as needed; personal vehicle and driving license are a plus

Benefits

  • Opportunity to grow with an expanding F&B brand

  • Direct experience in managing quality control for F&B outlets

  • Exposure to various aspects of food safety, product quality, and operational standards

  • Opportunity to participate in quality improvement programs

  • Learning & development with an experienced team

  • Collaborative and dynamic work environment

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Business Platform
jobs.description: Get to Know the Team We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Business Platform team in Jakarta, Indonesia. The Business Platform powers the backend capabilities that enable businesses and enterprises to onboard, operate, grow, and serve consumers at scale across Southeast Asia. Get to Know the Role In this role, you will design, build, and evolve backend platform services that manage business profiles, store metadata, business configuration, and related operational workflows. You'll work on systems that sit close to the source of truth for business data and workflows—systems that directly influence how businesses set up their operations, how internal teams operate reliably, and how downstream products consume trusted business information. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong ownership, system design thinking, and a commitment to building platforms that simplify complexity rather than spread it around. This is an onsite role based in Jakarta. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Lead the architectural design of microservices, high-throughput APIs, and data storage solutions built to handle scale and high availability. Diagnose high-stakes performance bottlenecks, refactor core infrastructure, and ensure low latency across distributed systems. Get to Know the Team

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Business Platform team in Jakarta, Indonesia. The Business Platform powers the backend capabilities that enable businesses and enterprises to onboard, operate, grow, and serve consumers at scale across Southeast Asia.

Get to Know the Role

In this role, you will design, build, and evolve backend platform services that manage business profiles, store metadata, business configuration, and related operational workflows. You'll work on systems that sit close to the source of truth for business data and workflows—systems that directly influence how businesses set up their operations, how internal teams operate reliably, and how downstream products consume trusted business information. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: Get to Know the Team At Financial Services, the Payment team builds end-to-end payment experiences and platforms that help merchants accept payments and grow across Southeast Asia. We empower frictionless checkouts with configurable, developer-friendly capabilities—so partners can embed payments and iterate quickly. From QR payments to lending repayments and in-person acceptance flows, we work across multiple payment journeys to deliver reliable user and merchant outcomes. Get to Know the Role We are looking for a experienced and passionate backend engineer to join our Tech Family. You will develop scalable backend systems that power products used by millions of people across Southeast Asia. You will be expected to take ownership of complex technical problems end to end, drive high-quality execution, and raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment, collaboration, and mentorship. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will be based in our Jakarta Office The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Lead the design, and operation of scalable, maintainable, and reliable backend services and platform components. Convert product and requirements into technical solutions while driving design discussions and architectural trade-offs. Oversee the delivery of high-quality code by maintaining standards in testing, performance, observability, and rigorous code reviews. Partner with product, business, mobile, web, data, and infrastructure teams to solve end-to-end-user and system challenges. Improve service reliability through monitoring, proactive system health fixes, incident response, and root cause analysis. Participate in the team's on-call rotation and take active ownership during production incidents. Guide engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. Identify and guide ongoing improvements in engineering processes, developer productivity, and overall system health.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs and Permitting Manager
jobs.description: About the job Our data centers support the digital services, businesses and ideas driving communities forward. As TERA grows in Indonesia, timely and disciplined regulatory execution is essential to keeping our projects on schedule, maintaining operational readiness and supporting responsible growth. Reporting to the Head of Public Policy and Government Affairs, the Regulatory Affairs and Permitting Manager will own the end to end execution of licenses, permits, registrations, regulatory approvals, amendments and renewals across development, construction, commissioning and operations. This is an operational delivery role. Broader stakeholder engagement and strategic resources policy are led by separate members of the team. Responsibilities Lead Regulatory Affairs and Permitting • Develop and maintain a complete regulatory and permitting roadmap for each data center campus, covering development, construction, commissioning, operations and renewal requirements. • Manage applications, amendments, renewals and maintenance of all required licenses, permits, registrations and regulatory approvals. • Identify applicable requirements under Indonesian business licensing and sector regulations, including requirements administered through OSS and relevant national and regional authorities. • Communicate directly with regulatory and licensing offices to clarify requirements, submit applications, respond to questions, follow up on processing and resolve application specific issues. Protect Project Delivery • Translate regulatory requirements into clear actions, document lists, accountable owners, dependencies and target completion dates for internal project teams. • Integrate permit and approval milestones into project schedules and identify regulatory risks that could affect construction, energization, commissioning or operations. • Maintain an accurate permit tracker and document repository, including application status, validity periods, renewal deadlines, dependencies, responsible owners and evidence of approval. • Escalate stalled, high risk or schedule critical approvals with a clear assessment of the issue, project impact, recommended action and required support. Coordinate Regulatory Execution • Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, Project Management, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Environment Health and Safety, Finance and external consultants to ensure submissions are complete, accurate and timely. • Monitor regulatory changes that directly affect licensing, permitting and data center operations, and communicate practical implications to relevant internal teams. • Coordinate with Stakeholder Relations when senior government engagement or institutional escalation is required, and with Strategic Resources Policy on matters involving electricity, water, telecommunications, land and other critical resources, while retaining ownership of permit execution. • Conduct all regulatory interactions and submissions in accordance with company ethics, anti bribery, record keeping and approval requirements. Minimum Qualifications • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Public Policy, Engineering or another relevant field. • At least 5 years of relevant experience in regulatory affairs, licensing, permitting, project approvals or operational compliance in Indonesia. • Hands on experience independently managing license or permit applications with government authorities and licensing offices. • Good working knowledge of Indonesian business licensing processes, including OSS, and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical project actions. • Strong project management, documentation, coordination, follow up and problem solving skills. • Ability to work effectively with technical teams and understand engineering or construction documents sufficiently to manage regulatory submissions. • Professional communication skills and the ability to work effectively with regulatory authorities, consultants and internal stakeholders. • Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English, with willingness to travel regularly to government offices, project sites and data center campuses. Preferred Qualifications • Experience in data centers, telecommunications, power, infrastructure, construction, industrial estates, manufacturing, energy or another regulated sector. • Experience managing regulatory requirements across multiple projects or campuses with competing deadlines and approval dependencies. • The ability to operate effectively in fast paced, ambiguous and resource constrained environments. • Mandarin proficiency is helpful but not required.

• Maintain an accurate permit tracker and document repository, including application status, validity periods, renewal deadlines, dependencies, responsible owners and evidence of approval.

• Escalate stalled, high risk or schedule critical approvals with a clear assessment of the issue, project impact, recommended action and required support.


Coordinate Regulatory Execution

• Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, Project Management, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Environment Health and Safety, Finance and external consultants to ensure submissions are complete, accurate and timely.

• Monitor regulatory changes that directly affect licensing, permitting and data center operations, and communicate practical implications to relevant internal teams.

• Coordinate with Stakeholder Relations when senior government engagement or institutional escalation is required, and with Strategic Resources Policy on matters involving electricity, water, telecommunications, land and other critical resources, while retaining ownership of permit execution.

• Conduct all regulatory interactions and submissions in accordance with company ethics, anti bribery, record keeping and approval requirements.


Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Public Policy, Engineering or another relevant field.

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in regulatory affairs, licensing, permitting, project approvals or operational compliance in Indonesia.

• Hands on experience independently managing license or permit applications with government authorities and licensing offices.

• Good working knowledge of Indonesian business licensing processes, including OSS, and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical project actions.

• Strong project management, documentation, coordination, follow up and problem solving skills.

• Ability to work effectively with technical teams and understand engineering or construction documents sufficiently to manage regulatory submissions.

• Professional communication skills and the ability to work effectively with regulatory authorities, consultants and internal stakeholders.

• Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English, with willingness to travel regularly to government offices, project sites and data center campuses.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in data centers, telecommunications, power, infrastructure, construction, industrial estates, manufacturing, energy or another regulated sector.

• Experience managing regulatory requirements across multiple projects or campuses with competing deadlines and approval dependencies.

• The ability to operate effectively in fast paced, ambiguous and resource constrained environments.

• Mandarin proficiency is helpful but not required.

jobs.title: Finance Staff
jobs.description: FINANCE STAFF Job Responsibilities Assist the Finance Head in daily finance and administrative activities. Handle and monitor Accounts Payable (AP) transactions, including invoices, payment requests, and supporting documents. Handle and monitor Accounts Receivable (AR) transactions, including tenant billing and payment collections. Monitor and follow up on tenant payments , ensuring payments are received according to the agreed terms. Maintain accurate records of tenant receivables, payment status, outstanding balances, and related documents. Check the completeness and accuracy of financial documents before processing. Maintain and monitor finance-related contracts, agreements, payment terms, and important deadlines. Review transactions and documents to ensure compliance with company procedures and internal controls. Identify and promptly report discrepancies, irregularities, or unusual transactions to the Finance Head or Management. Coordinate with Accounting, Finance, Procurement, tenants, and other relevant parties regarding invoices, payments, contracts, and financial documentation. Coordinate with factory personnel when required for document collection, verification, and follow-up. Assist with reconciliations, financial reporting, documentation, and other finance-related tasks as assigned. Occasionally visit the company’s factory or other company locations for finance-related coordination or verification. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Good understanding of basic accounting and finance principles. Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills. Good communication and coordination skills. Responsible, trustworthy, and proactive in following up on tasks and outstanding payments. Able to identify discrepancies and appropriately escalate issues to the Finance Head or Management. Good command of English and/or Mandarin is an asset . Able to work independently and collaboratively with different departments and external parties. Willing to occasionally travel to the company’s factory or other company locations when required. Recruitment Process Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend an offline HR Test and Interview at our Jakarta office .

This is an active...", "content2": "Villa Operations Supervisor

Location: Bingin / Uluwatu, Bali
Position: Full-time

We are looking for a hands-on Villa Operations Supervisor to manage the daily operations of 7 luxury private villas in Bingin.

This is an active onsite role. You will supervise the housekeeping team, communicate with guests and make sure every villa is clean, well maintained and guest-ready.

Main Responsibilities

  • Manage the daily operations of 7 villas

  • Coordinate and supervise the housekeeping team + poolattendent and daily schedule

  • Personally check villa quality before every guest arrival

  • Monitor and respond to Airbnb / Guesty messages and guest requests

  • Coordinate check-ins, check-outs and special guest requests

  • Assist guests and make sure problems and requests are fully resolved

  • Identify maintenance issues and coordinate technicians/handymen

  • Check pool, garden, linen, amenities and villa supplies

  • Make sure Bali Bliss Villa SOPs and quality standards are followed

  • Provide Management with a short daily operational update

We Are Looking For Someone Who

  • Has experience in luxury villa, 5*hotel or hospitality operations

  • Has experience supervising housekeeping or operational staff

  • Speaks good English and Bahasa Indonesia

  • Is comfortable communicating with international guests

  • Is comfortable using WhatsApp and systems such as Airbnb / Guesty

  • Is organised, detail-oriented and has high hospitality standards

  • Takes initiative, follows up and gets things done

  • Is reliable, responsible and professional

  • Preferably lives in or close to Bingin / Uluwatu, must live in Bali already

  • Is available to work weekends/public holidays according to the schedule

What You Can Expect

  • Good basic salary

  • Full-time employment contract

  • BPJS

  • Meal allowance

  • THR

  • Full upselling bonus

  • Share in guest tips

  • 12 days annual leave

  • Training and support

  • A professional and friendly team to work with

Most Important

We are looking for someone who takes ownership.

When there is a problem, we expect you to take action, follow up and make sure it is solved.

Reporting a problem is not enough — we are looking for someone who gets things done.

Perform other cybersecurity, network security, and infrastructure-related tasks as required.

jobs.title: SALES ASURARANSI BANCASSURANCE - AREA MAKASSAR
jobs.description: Manulife Financial Corporation adalah penyedia jasa keuangan internasional terkemuka yang berdiri sejak 1887. Beroperasi sebagai Manulife di Kanada, Asia, dan Eropa, serta sebagai John Hancock di Amerika Serikat. PT Asuransi Jiwa Manulife Indonesia atau Manulife Indonesia adalah perusahaan penyedia jasa keuangan yang berfokus pada asuransi jiwa, asuransi kesehatan, dan pengelolaan dana pensiun. Berdiri sejak tahun 1985 beroperasi di lebih dari 50 kantor pemasaran di Indonesia serta melayani sekitar 2 juta nasabah. Memiliki jalur distribusi yang kuat serta beragam, untuk menjangkau dan melindungi semakin banyak keluarga Indonesia seperti : Agency, Bancassurance, Employee Benefit dan Syariah. Untuk Lini Bancassurance, Manulife Indonesia berkerjasama dengan beberapa bank partner seperti Bank DBS dan Bank Danamon Indonesia. Dimana saat ini sedang membuka lowongan untuk posisi bancassurance untuk penempatan Bank Danamon Indonesia. Deskripsi pekerjaan : Bekerja sama dengan Mitra bank dan Staff Bank dalam merekomendasikan, mempromosikan, memasarkan dan menjual produk kepada nasabah Melayani pertanyaan dari Mitra Bank, nasabah maupun calon nasabah mengenai produk Termasuk dengan memberikan layanan purna jual kepada nasabah PERSYARATAN : Memiliki pendidikan minimal S1 sederajat dari berbagai jurusan Usia maksimal 38 tahun Memiliki pengalaman di Perbankan / Insurance min 1 tahun Memiliki ketertarikan di bidang Sales & Marketing Representatif Memiliki kemampuan berkomunikasi dan hubungan interpersonal yang baik Memiliki kemampuan interpersonal yang baik termasuk dengan komunitas profesional Terbuka kesempatan untuk penempatan di kantor cabang Bank Danamon seluruh area Makassar

Excellent command of English, both spoken and written.

Good interpersonal and communication skills towards students, parents and other colleagues.

Experienced in teaching English would be a preference.

Experience teaching offline and online classes

Have TOEFL score minimum 550 or IELTS minimum 6.5 (optional)

Able to commit to a minimum of one year contract

In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs while ensuring high performance, security, and seamless database integration. This opportunity is ideal for experienced developers with 4–5+ years of hands-on expertise who are detail-oriented, strong problem solvers, and ready to build robust backend solutions in a collaborative project environment. JOB DESCRIPTIONS : Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Golang. Build scalable and reliable RESTful APIs and backend services. Develop and integrate services with databases and third-party systems. Ensure application performance, reliability, security, and scalability. Collaborate with Frontend/Mobile Developers, Product, and QA teams. Perform code reviews, debugging, testing, and performance optimization. Identify and resolve technical issues across development and production environments. Maintain clean, maintainable code and technical documentation. Participate in technical discussions, sprint activities, and weekly offline meetings. Contribute to backend architecture and continuous improvement initiatives. JOB REQUIREMENTS : Minimum 4–5 years of experience as a Golang or Backend Developer. Strong proficiency in Golang, RESTful API design, and microservices architecture. Solid understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases and database optimization. Proficient with Git, unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning. Experience with Docker, CI/CD, or cloud platforms is a plus. Good understanding of software architecture, scalability, and security best practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Intermediate English proficiency (written and verbal) for team collaboration. Willing to work in a hybrid setup in Yogyakarta with weekly offline meetings.

jobs.title: Manager Operational
jobs.description: Manager Operational bertanggung jawab dalam mengelola dan mengawasi seluruh operasional outlet agar berjalan efisien, produktif, dan sesuai standar perusahaan . Posisi ini berperan dalam perencanaan, pelaksanaan, dan evaluasi operasional harian hingga bulanan , mencakup manajemen stok bahan, pengelolaan keuangan, pengaturan jadwal kerja dan MPP, pembinaan kinerja crew, serta pengendalian kualitas produk dan pelayanan . Head Store juga memiliki wewenang untuk mengambil keputusan cepat pada situasi operasional mendesak , melakukan validasi data keuangan, HPP, dan labour , serta memastikan pencapaian target omzet dan kepuasan customer . Selain itu, jabatan ini berperan sebagai leader sekaligus penghubung antar divisi (operasional, finance, HR, dan marketing) guna menjaga kesinambungan dan performa store secara keseluruhan

jobs.title: LEGAL PERMIT & GOVERNMENT SPECIALIST
jobs.description: RESPONSIBILITIES: Assist in the preparation and submission of permitting documents related to Operational Store Familiar with coordination with DPMPTSP, Bapenda, Satpol PP, Dinas Lingkungan Hidup, Dinas Kesehatan, and other relevant government authorities. Experience managing permits and compliance for multiple restaurants outlets across different cities/regions is highly preferred. Collect and verify required information and documentation to meet licensing and permitting requirements. Ensure the accuracy and completeness of the company’s permitting archives and databases. Assist in drafting reports and presentations regarding legal compliance and permitting status. Manage and process local tax compliance for outlet signage, billboards, and outdoor advertisements (Pajak Reklame), including permit renewals and coordination with regional tax offices (Bapenda). Proficient in operating Indonesia’s OSS-RBA system and preparing/submitting the Investment Activity Report (LKPM). Good understanding of NIB, KBLI, Sertifikat Standar, PB-UMKU, and other business licensing requirements relevant to restaurant operations. Handle other local utility and environmental taxes/levies, ensuring all outlet assessments are legally compliant and processed on schedule. Strong ability to monitor permit validity, renewal deadlines, regulatory changes and compliance status. To record and update legal documentation (Permit & Goverment Relation) properly To ensure proper administration work in legal department REQUIREMENTS: Minimal Bachelor of Law from reputable university At least 2 years working experience in a permitting or Government Relations in house legal and familiar with FnB or Retail Business Strong understanding of property law, and basic environmental law Flexible to travel regularly across outlet locations to manage on-site permit installations, verify signage tax placements, and coordinate directly with local authorities Hands-on and pro-active, able to work both independently and as a team

jobs.title: Senior Kotlin Developer
jobs.description: We are hiring a Senior Kotlin Developer for a hybrid opportunity in Yogyakarta to design, build, and maintain high-quality mobile applications. In this role, you will drive the development and scaling of high-performance mobile applications while collaborating with cross-functional product teams in an English-speaking environment to deliver robust, high-quality user experiences. Ideal candidates possess 4–5+ years of experience in mobile applications development using Kotlin, strong proficiency in Android SDK and clean architecture. JOB DESCRIPTIONS : Develop and maintain high-quality mobile applications using Kotlin. Design and implement scalable, reliable, and maintainable application features. Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services into mobile applications. Collaborate with Product, UI/UX, Backend, and QA teams throughout the development lifecycle. Perform code reviews, debugging, testing, and performance optimization. Identify and resolve technical issues to ensure application stability. Maintain clean code, technical documentation, and development standards. Participate in technical discussions and weekly offline meetings. Contribute to continuous improvement of application architecture and development processes. JOB REQUIREMENTS : Minimum 4–5 years of experience in Kotlin and Android development. Solid understanding of Android SDK, Jetpack, Clean Architecture, and design patterns. Experience integrating RESTful APIs and third-party services. Proficient with Git, testing, debugging, and performance optimization. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Intermediate English proficiency (written and verbal) for working in an English-speaking team. Willing to work in a hybrid setup in Yogyakarta with weekly offline meetings.
